author: Torta
summary: In 2019 dual specialization was called impossible server-side; a saved-spec device shipped later in 1.15 instead.
quote: This would require quite major client's modification, can't be done server side

author: Torta
topic_title: Shamns for Alliance and Palains for Horde
summary: Alliance shamans and Horde paladins were ruled out in 2019 as requiring major client and server modification.
quote: This is not possible without major and very complicated client and server modifications. So the answer is 100% no

author: Torta
topic_title: Free respec for levels 10-59. No xp loss in dung.
summary: The 5 gold respec cost is fixed and will not be lowered; hardcore XP loss exists to make players think twice and the mode is optional.
quote: Current respect costs is 5 gold. Lowering or removal isn't an option ... It's designed to ensure that people think twice prior doing. It's optional, we are not forcing anyone to play in HM

author: Gheor
topic_title: Priest racials available to other races
summary: Race-specific priest racials stay as a vanilla feature; sharing them would break lore.
quote: It's part of the vanilla experience and by no means has anyone been tossed out of raid groups for not being a dwarf priest ... Short answer: Denied

author: Gheor
summary: High Elf racials were designed from lore; Spell Steal is treated as a Blood Elf trait and therefore excluded.
quote: Spell steal is a blood elf thing, we made the racials according to lore

author: Torta
summary: Plainsrunning being interrupted on spell cast is a deliberate 2020 change, not a PvP measure: unrestricted it let Taurens kite bosses with a 60-100% speed buff as a mount without mount restrictions.
quote: Initial implementation was too OP because it'd allow Taurens to kite bosses and engage in battles with creatures while having a 60-100% speed buff, and basically be on mount without having normal mounting restrictions. So it will not be reverted and working as intended.

author: Gheor
summary: New hunter pet families cannot be added.
quote: We can't add new hunter pet families.

author: Torta
topic_title: Poll: Undead Hunters — yes or not?
summary: Admission that even vanilla's own race/class combos are inconsistent, citing Undead Holy Priests, so strict lore purity is not the only filter.
quote: I agree that even existing class / race combos are not perfect. Lore consistency is a good thing but in this case it makes no sense to think what's possible and what's not. We have Undead Holy Priests already, you know.

author: Torta
summary: Original design of the Goblin Brainwashing Device: save two talent configurations and switch between them at the normal talent-reset cost; action bars are not restored.
quote: Goblin Brainwashing Device will allow you to save two talent configurations as primary and secondary ... Cost of activating is still the same as a talent reset.

author: Torta
topic_title: Poll: Undead Hunters — yes or not?
summary: After a community poll both Dwarf Mages and Undead Hunters were added; Human Hunters were blocked by the client's six-class UI limit.
quote: Based on the feedback, we've made a decision to add both new class/race combos: Dwarf Mages and Undead Hunters in the upcoming client update.

author: Gheor
topic_title: Expand available race/class options with expansion
summary: Race/class combinations are gated by lore consistency and the client's six-class character-creation limit; Undead Hunters and Dwarf Mages were approved, Troll and Dwarf Druids rejected as Cataclysm lore.
quote: Undead Hunter will be a thing with the next patch ... As for Human Hunter we are sadly limited by the 6 classes/race limit that's in the character creation screen ... Everyone has a different way to reason for any class/race combo but there must be some logic and it must not break the lore.

author: Dragunovi
topic_title: Final Changelog for Class Changes coming in 1.16.1
summary: Paladin's taunt via Judgement of Justice is deliberately awkward: it is a tank-swap tool of last resort, not a free taunt, so hybrids do not overshadow dedicated tanks.
quote: This is intentional ... the intention was to give them a tool to handle tank swaps, not a free "face me" card basically, like how Druids are the jack of all trades, master of none, hybrids shouldn't be the best at everything and overshadow dedicated specialization classes

author: Dragunovi
topic_title: Final Changelog for Class Changes coming in 1.16.1
summary: Rogue Flourish granting 20% parry (enabling a 100% avoidance rogue tank) is intentional.
quote: İntentional, no clue who can pull off rogue tanking, but they should have the required mitigation tool now.

author: Gheor
summary: Turtle's custom spells are written from scratch for Vanilla, even where later expansions inspired them; nothing is downported or copy-pasted.
quote: The spells were created from scratch to fit Vanilla. Even if our spellmaker took inspiration from another expansion they were not downported or copy pasted.

author: Jamey
topic_title: Final Changelog for Class Changes coming in 1.16.1
summary: Rationale for changing vanilla class design at all: some vanilla abilities, talents and class niches were overlooked or abandoned and Turtle aims to revitalise them.
quote: while the overwhelmingy majority of their decisions were sound and made sense, some abilities,talents or class niches felt overlooked or abandoned which is something we're trying to revitalise with most of these changes.

author: Akalix
topic_title: A new class added to the game
summary: Custom classes are wanted long-term but deprioritised behind existing custom content.
quote: It would take a tremendous amount of work to release a new class in a condition we'd feel proud of. It is something we'd definitely love to do in the future, however, we have many other updates we're going to do first.

author: Gheor
topic_title: The Option for Goblins to become Priests!
summary: Dwarf Mages were a scrapped Blizzard alpha feature simply re-enabled with their class quests, not a Cataclysm import.
quote: Dwarven Mages were made available because they were supposed to be Mages when Vanilla would've launched. It was an Alpha feature which got scrapped. We simply activated the class again and its class quests.

author: Akalix
summary: Extending blessing duration to 30 minutes was resisted because swapping Might/Kings/Wisdom per pull is meaningful; the team preferred to change Paladins elsewhere.
quote: 30 minutes would be much longer than I think fits. One example for needing to adapt the buffs would be hunters, as Might/Kings/Wisdom all can be viable depending on the pull.

author: Akalix
summary: Weapon skill kept as an old-RPG staple; racial changes offered as the more likely lever. Consistent with the 2024 dev blog.
quote: We do not currently plan to remove weapon skills, as they are a staple feature of the old-RPG feel in vanilla WoW. While they do impact endgame, they are a very immersive feature.

author: Torta
summary: Judgement of Light healing is credited to the attacking unit as in retail vanilla, so the paladin no longer gets PvP-flagged when a flagged player attacks the same mob.
quote: Judgement of Light healing will now be done by the unit that's attacking as is blizzlike. This means the paladin will no longer get flagged for PvP when another flagged player attacks the same mob.

author: Akalix
summary: No race on Turtle will ever be able to roll every class.
quote: Won't be one on Turtle.

author: Torta
summary: Human hunters are justified in-lore by High Elf refugee training camps in Elwynn Forest; the team will not switch to dwarven trainers.
quote: A massive amount of High Elven refugees are coming from Farstrider Lodge to the Elwynn Forest. I'ts only natural they'd want to establish a few training camps for their hunters here and there, and nothing stops humans from joining them!

author: Pepesmite
summary: Shamans will never wear plate; the team refuses drastic changes to the original class concepts, and supports shaman tanking through items instead.
quote: That's never going to happen. We do not intend to make drastic changes to the original concept of the classes. Shamans use leather and chain mail thats all.

author: Torta
summary: Tree of Life aura healing bonus reduced to 20% of Spirit.
quote: Reduced the healing bonus from Tree of Life aura to only 20% of Spirit.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: Execute costs all of my rage
summary: Execute consuming all remaining rage is intended per the spell tooltip.
quote: Please read the spell notification. It works as intended

author: Jamey
summary: Free unlimited talent resets via the Goblin Brainwashing Device were a bug, not a feature; changed because raiders respecced up to 10 times per raid.
quote: the Goblin Brainwashing Device was never meant to allow people saving a specialization with only 1 talent point spent, essentially allowing infinite free talent resets ... Players would reset their talents mid-raid, sometimes up to 10 times per raid to get specific benefits per fight. This is not something we consider healthy for the game

author: Torta
summary: The first class-change batch was deliberately conservative and left vanilla imbalance largely intact; 1.17.2 takes a deeper pass meant as a long-term foundation.
quote: While we're happy with the first batch of class changes, they were done under a much more conservative mindset with minor changes, and so vanilla's unbalanced state was still very much felt ... we're finally taking a deeper dive into balancing and building a solid foundation that'll serve as the core for all specializations for years to come.

author: Akalix
summary: Weapon skill is not being removed; racial weapon skill bonuses nerfed but not deleted, weapon-vs-defense skill linearized, +5 skill bonuses added from other sources, so race no longer dictates class viability.
quote: Weapon skill is not being removed. The system belongs in an RPG game such as World of Warcraft ... a racial weapon skill bonus shouldn't prevent someone from making a Gnome warrior—only good taste should. ... Racial Weapon Skill Bonuses will be nerfed, while not entirely removed. Linearizing Weapon Skill vs Defense Skill to make the breakpoints much more clear. Adding +5 skill bonus rewards from various sources.

author: Jamey
summary: Racial niches are kept but the 'must pick this race' pressure is removed; race-change services rejected as homogenizing.
quote: We want to keep that "niche" of specific races alive while also removing the "I HAVE TO pick this race if I want to be any good at x or y" without resorting to racial-swapping as that plays more into homogenization and the "everyone is special" narrative.

author: Akalix
summary: Circulating ability/talent lists were suggestions from team members, chosen community members and forum posts, not confirmed additions.
quote: Please note that these are suggestions, not confirmed additions ... None of these are guaranteed to be implemented and should not be assumed to be reflective of the final product.

author: Torta
summary: Only one Goblin Brainwashing Device may be active in an area, aimed at players deliberately blocking others.
quote: You can no longer use a Goblin Brainwashing Device if another one is already nearby.

author: Akalix
summary: Freezing Trap and Scatter Shot sharing diminishing returns is a blizzlike bugfix, not a nerf; both shared DR in vanilla and classic.
quote: This is a bugfix to behave blizzlike, as both in classic and vanilla those abilities shared DR.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Druid design goals in Class Changes 2: Hurricane's attack-speed slow moved to a Balance talent so its cooldown could be halved and its spell-power scaling raised; Tranquility reworked because the vanilla version does not live up to its Warcraft 3 legacy; feral dodge made to generate rage.
quote: we removed the attack speed slow and moved it to the Balance tree as a talent. This allowed us to reduce Hurricane's cooldown by half, while also strengthening its scaling with the Spell Power stat. Tranquility is an iconic spell from Warcraft 3 ... its World of Warcraft counterpart sadly does not live up to its legacy.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Bear druids get rage from dodge because Agility forces dodge on them while, unlike warrior block, dodge generated nothing; Feral Adrenaline gives a reaction window after a crit.
quote: While blocking generates rage for warriors, dodging does not for druids. Still, they cannot avoid accumulating this stat due to how Agility grants additional dodge chance.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Hunter problems named for Class Changes 2: Marksmanship's power sat outside its tree, Survival lacked identity, Beast Mastery did not scale for raids, and pet choice was narrow. Aimed Shot goes baseline, Trueshot renamed Steady Shot, pet Avoidance raised 50%->80%, two extra stable slots.
quote: Marksmanship's power being unattached from its talent tree for the most part. Survival lacking identity. Beast Mastery's viability in raid environments due to lacking scaling. Pet choices being very limited due to some cutting way ahead of the rest.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Pets and demons have no source of hit chance in raids; a talent now transfers the owner's hit, and it also applies to Intimidation and Growl.
quote: Pets generally struggle with hitting their targets in raid environments due to lacking any source of hit chance gain, this talent aims to alleviate this issue ... the spell hit chance also applies to the Intimidation talent and the Growl threat generation ability.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Mage goals: Fire and Frost rotations were bland and Arcane lacked viability and identity, so Arcane was majorly reworked around resist-driven spells (Arcane Surge) fitting a wild, uncontrollable school.
quote: Fire and Frost both have their spots and deal good damage, but their rotations are infamously bland compared to other classes, meanwhile Arcane has a lot of issues with its viability and identity ... making it a specialization fitting the nature of Arcane as a spell school that's wild and uncontrollable.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Ignite was reworked because the shared debuff loaded all its threat onto the mage who applied it, and because fewer Fire mages would hurt its uptime once Arcane became attractive.
quote: Ignite has issues with being a debuff that is contributed to by all the Fire Mages in a group but loading all the threat into the initial applying Mage.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Paladin history and rationale: vanilla Paladin is treated as unfinished (Crusader Strike and Holy Strike cut before release); Turtle's restored beta Holy Strike proved unbalanced with percentage damage increases and in PvP, and beta Crusader Strike produced a downrank-spam loop, so both were rebuilt.
quote: The design of the Paladin class in Vanilla is often considered unfinished ... Just before release, both Crusader Strike and Holy Strike were removed ... Holy Strike ... was also quite unbalanced in scenarios with percentage damage increases or in player combat.

author: Dragunovi
summary: The Judgement of Justice taunt experiment was judged clunky (two GCDs and heavy mana to return to rotation) and replaced with a baseline paladin taunt.
quote: Experiment with Judgement of Justice being a taunt was a worthy one, but it missed the mark in a few places ... We have decided to give paladins a baseline taunt

author: Dragunovi
summary: Reckoning was rebuilt around blocking rather than being critically struck, which the team calls a failed vanilla design because tanks do not want to be crit.
quote: Reckoning as it was was purely a joke ability which relied on getting critically struck just like old Redoubt. It was a failed design of Vanilla, as tanks actively don't want to be critically struck because in many cases it leads to damage spikes and death.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Old Vindication never worked against creatures because mobs have no Agility/Strength values; it was replaced with an effect that actually functions.
quote: Old Vindication was straight up not working against non-player enemies, due to mobs not having Agility and Strength values.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Priest goals: Discipline was neglected in batch one and existed only as a dip, and Holy performed so independently of its own tree that players specced into Discipline instead; Inner Fire now grants spell damage rather than attack power.
quote: Discipline was quite neglected in our first batch of changes, failing to give it tools that allows it to be functional and viable by itself ... the Holy tree is quite independent of its talent tree to perform well as a healer, perhaps too independent.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Night Elf priests can wield bows as a Warcraft 3 / Priestess of Elune lore callback.
quote: To reflect the origin of Night Elf priests in the Priestess of the Moon, we are giving them the ability to wield bows, just like Tyrande Whisperwind did in Warcraft 3.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Rogue baseline changes: combo points persist through target switches (resetting only when applied to a new target), rogues can use one-handed axes, Ghostly Strike and Heightened Senses go baseline, Sinister Strike costs 40 energy, and Corrosive Poison bypasses Nature/poison immunity.
quote: Combo Points will no longer vanish upon switching targets, but instead reset when applying combo points on a new target ... Rogues can now wield One-Handed Axes ... its corrosive properties allows it to bypass conventional Nature and poison immunities

author: Dragunovi
summary: Windfury Totem was cut back because in vanilla it made up too much of the shaman's contribution while making other temporary weapon enchants irrelevant; Windfury Weapon was nerfed after Enhancement tested hundreds of DPS ahead of every other spec.
quote: its Vanilla implementation was too big of a percentage of Shaman's overall output, pushing their personal performance down while it also made other temporary weapon enchants like sharpening stones or rogue poisons irrelevant ... Enhancement performed as an overwhelmingly strong outlier ... by pulling ahead of every single dps spec in the game by several hundreds of damage per second.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Bloodlust reworked to buff the shaman first with party support scaling off the shaman's own contribution; stated itemization principle that set bonuses should add to a class's strengths, not be their foundation (Stormcaller 5-piece removed).
quote: Bloodlust was reworked to be a buff for the shaman first and foremost ... with the philosophy that items should add on top of a class' strengths and not be the entire foundation of them.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Warlock goal: all three specs played as a Shadow Bolt turret, so changes aim at distinct rotations; Soul Shards stack to 3 and Soul Bags gain a 5-25% chance not to consume a reagent.
quote: they all were just a Shadow Bolt turret with barely any differences in gameplay. New changes will focus on enabling new spell rotations that better reinforce the fantasy of playing each of the specializations.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Warrior rage formula reworked because vanilla's damage-to-rage conversion only works well for geared level 60 raiders and punishes everyone else; Shield Slam-style talents retuned because Improved Shield Block doubles an ability already granting crit and crush immunity.
quote: While Vanilla's system shines for late 60 raiders, unfortunately everywhere else, players are harshly punished and suffering rage-starvation

author: Dragunovi
summary: The off-hand hit penalty mechanic was replaced by Dual Wield Specialization hit, and a two-handed change was made explicitly to reduce the advantage of low-latency players.
quote: This change will help two-handed warrior builds and reduce the unfair advantage of players with better internet connection.

author: Jamey
summary: Racial rebalance rationale and figures: Horde combat racials historically stronger, so outliers were evened out while keeping flavour — Will of the Forsaken 4s->3s and 2min->2.5min, Blood Fury AP doubled and off-GCD, Shadowmeld 3min->1min, War Stomp 1.5s->2s, Vengeance limited to non-player humanoids.
quote: it is common knowledge that the Horde has always had the upper hand when it comes to combat racials, especially in PvP. Our changes to these Racials sought to remedy this issue by keeping Racials unique and flavorful to their race while evening out the power of the outliers.

author: Akalix
summary: No Alliance shamans or Horde paladins are planned; Nordanaar has full cross-faction grouping while Tel'Abim has none.
quote: we do not plan to add Shamans to the Alliance or Paladins to the Horde, however some realms have crossfaction.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Reconsidering the Goblin Brainwashing Device nerf: a key Quality of Life feature
summary: The absence of reported exploits was itself part of the reason for the later Brainwashing Device change, alongside undisclosed design reasons.
quote: This was actually one of the reasons this change was made. However, it was also made for design purposes

author: Akalix
topic_title: Stages of Balance in Tower of Karazhan
summary: Goals of the Class Changes 2 update and a staged balancing plan (release, bugfix/feedback, then tuning); AoE Repentance named as an unforeseen outlier.
quote: Our goals within this update is increasing specialization diversity, allowing build diversity, and decreasing restrictions on Class builds and Class+Race combinations in PvE and PvP ... This has mostly gone well except for a few cases (looking at you AoE Repentance)

author: Jamey
summary: Class Changes 2 will not be reverted.
quote: As for the whole of CC2, it will not be reverted.

author: Lhian
summary: Number tweaks before Karazhan's release; design changes remain open after the raid is cleared, contradicting a player claim that only numbers would change until CC3.
quote: That's untrue. There will be number tweak before the release of Tower of Karazhan, but we are open to design changes after the dust settles in after the raid is cleared.

author: Akalix
summary: No class change service: it would undercut RPG character progression.
quote: We do not plan to implement a "class change" feature as it would be very against the idea of character progression which is core to a RPG like WoW.

author: Jamey
summary: The talent calculator reflected 1.18.0 before the patch went live.
quote: It's not. 1.18.0 isn't live yet.

author: Jamey
summary: The disputed Shaman tier-set / Chain Heal interaction is confirmed intended.
quote: That interaction is intended. As was said by a green name.

author: Torta
summary: The vanilla client keeps its own channel list and ignores server-side changes, so auto-joining a custom channel is impossible without client modification or an addon.
quote: we can't force the client to join custom channel without modifying it or creating an addon. It's only possible in WotLK 3.x.x+ clients via "chatcache hack" ... Client maintains its own list and will ignore all server-side changes.

author: Torta
topic_title: Increase max. quest log amount from 20 to 40
summary: The 20-quest log cap is imposed by the client and network protocol and cannot be raised with Blizzard's quest components.
quote: quest log size is limited by the client and network protocol, we can't do it with the Blizzard quest components.

author: Torta
summary: Green 'Use:' text strings live in client files and cannot be created server-side, and some gear models have no icon display data, producing question-mark icons.
quote: Green text strings are part of the client files. We can't create new. Same goes for the question marks: not all the the gear models have an icon display data.

author: Torta
summary: A custom server-side spell fails client-side checks unless its template exists in client files — the stated limit of working without client modification.
quote: Custom server-side spell won't pass initial client-side checks without having its template in the client files. These are cons of working with someone else's game.

author: Torta
summary: Item tooltips are handled entirely client-side, so they cannot be corrected from the server.
quote: We can't do it. Tooltips are handles client side, not from server.

author: Torta
topic_title: Shop items as custom spells or commands
summary: In 2020 the team refused mandatory client updates, so illusions ran on unnamed dummy spells; chat commands were rejected as immersion-breaking.
quote: Implementing custom spell without having client-modifications is not the option, at least right now. We are not resorting to mandatory client updates yet! ... Commands are easy but immersion-breaking. Wouldn't go for it.

author: Torta
summary: Reaffirms the quest log cap as a client-side limitation.
quote: Yes, unfortunately there's a client-side limitation for this. Shame, it could make a great quality of life change.

author: Torta
summary: In 2020 a mandatory third-party launcher was rejected in favour of server-to-client updates — later reversed when the official launcher shipped in November 2024 and became required for some features.
quote: we're not planning to force our users to install 3rd party software on a mandatory basis. Our expansion updates will be sent directly from server to client

author: Torta
summary: DiscordOverlay.dll open-sourced with PDBs after Windows Defender false positives.
quote: Windows Defender has been falsely blocking our DiscordOverlay.dll. We decided to go open source to prove that there is no harmful content inside the library in question.

author: Torta
topic_title: Turtle Wow Update and Trojan Problem
summary: Being unable to sign binaries is named as a reason many private servers avoid custom client work at all.
quote: This is one the the reasons why many private WoW servers don't like to go custom: it's not really possible for us to distribute update without problems like Blizzard would do.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Noggit, the terrain editor, works poorly on vanilla and deletes water on edited chunks, limiting terrain work.
quote: Sadly Noggit doesn't work very well on Vanilla, deleting water on edited chunks so we can't utilise it to its full power.

author: Gheor
summary: NPCs cannot be placed on moving transports in this client generation.
quote: adding NPCs to a moving object is impossible due to the nature of the game itself, prior to WOTLK the boats have been so from what I can remember.

author: Torta
topic_title: Improved Field of View in 1.15.2 — Yes or No?
summary: No client source available, so FoV cannot become an in-game video option; two binaries planned instead.
quote: We don't have client source files (since it's Blizzards) to perform any heavy modifications. There'll be probably 2 binary files with FoV and without.

author: Gheor
summary: A Dark Ranger appearance for Undead would require replacing the Undead race with the High Elf race, which the client cannot sustain.
quote: You'd have to litterally change the Undead race into the High Elf one and such, the client can't sustain it

author: Jamey
summary: Expanding the visible debuff limit is only feasible via a UI addon; pure client modification was called infeasible. The server-side limit was later raised to 64 in 2023.
quote: This would be possible through the use of an addon modifying the UI. And while it would also be possible to do it through client modifications solely, it would be completely infeasible.

author: Torta
summary: Editing WoW model animations is beyond the team's current ability.
quote: Editing WoW model's animation is extremely hard task, and we're not able to do that yet.

author: Torta
summary: High Elf model and animation fixes were blocked in 2022 by having no active modeler with vanilla-model skills.
quote: we do not have an active modeler and it's very hard to find people with the right skill-set to work with the old Vanilla models.

author: Jamey
summary: Antivirus flags come from the patcher writing a file and editing WoW.exe to load the Discord library; the team lacks the whitelist status of large vendors and plans to sign the binary.
quote: These antiviruses however do not trigger on them because they're big companies that have requested explicit whitelist permissions etc. We're not one of these big companies and thus can't enjoy the same exclusivity they have but rest assured all antivirus flags are false positives.

author: Jamey
summary: Antivirus false positives are explained as the patcher extracting a file and editing WoW.exe to inject the Discord library.
quote: the false positive most likely comes from the patcher extracting a new file to the file system, and modifying WoW.exe to load Discords library ... Because editing a binary file is sometimes suspect for Antiviruses to pick up on.

author: Torta
topic_title: Armored Azure Drake and other dragons...
summary: Fully custom models are out of reach and post-WotLK models are too high-detail to sit alongside vanilla art.
quote: we cannot really design fully custom models. Also, any models post-WotLK are very hard to downport, nor we should: they're too HD and stand out from the rest of the game graphics.

author: Jamey
topic_title: Armored Azure Drake and other dragons...
summary: Explanation of why custom models are hard: the modding scene targets WotLK, vanilla formats differ, so tools must be written or adapted in-house by people who know both modelling and vanilla formats.
quote: The client has undergone a lot of changes between these two versions of the game and thus a lot of tools that are public are simply useless to us. Meaning we have to develop them ourselves or modify them

author: Akalix
topic_title: Armored Azure Drake and other dragons...
summary: Moving to a newer client base has been discussed repeatedly but would cost months without content.
quote: It'll take a LOT of time. Not everybody would be open to months of no content just for a new client.

author: Akalix
summary: The patcher is unsigned because obtaining a digital signature would expose the server and team to litigation; hashsums are offered instead.
quote: This is all caused due to a lack of Digital Signature. We do not have one as it would put the server and our team in danger of litigation.

author: Torta
summary: Extending the quest log is nearly impossible without the client source.
quote: It's nearly impossible to extend a quest log size in the Vanilla client without having its source code.

author: Torta
summary: The 1.14 (64-bit) client cannot be used against Turtle because the server's custom additions are incompatible.
quote: No. It's impossible. Our custom additions are not compatible.

author: Torta
summary: The quest log limit sits in a fixed array of unit fields and cannot be exceeded; a replacement quest UI would take months and risk severe bugs.
quote: It's not possible, it's in the fixed array of unit fields. Can't go beyond it.

author: Torta
summary: A replacement quest UI to lift the quest log limit is rejected as months of work, little gain and near-certain severe bugs.
quote: Yes, there could be a replacement UI for quests: but it might cause a lot of complications if we change the way the server communicates with the client about quest stuff. Basically, it's just months of work for very little gain and with 99% probability of really bad bugs.

author: Torta
summary: The 1.12 client's six-class-button limit on the character creation screen was raised by a client patch.
quote: We're raising the limit in the upcoming patch, to display more than six buttons on a character creation screen.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Make Legion landscape textures(only) permanent part of Turtle client
summary: Base game graphics will not be replaced; HD packs stay optional player-side mods.
quote: we will not be changing the base graphics of the game, as we are a vanilla server at our core identity.

author: Bowser
summary: Official performance guidance: do not run VanillaTweaks and VanillaFixes together if crashing, and avoid the DXVK build on pre-2016 graphics hardware.
quote: it's important to avoid using both Vanillatweaks and Vanillafixes together if you encounter crashes ... If you have an older graphics card like the Intel HD3000, it's advisable to avoid using the DXVK version of Vanillafixes.

author: Pepesmite
summary: The Looking For Team tool is a third-party addon, not a server mechanic; its bugs belong on the author's GitHub and it can be disabled in the start menu.
quote: LFT is not actually a game mechanic, but rather an addon ... the client we're using is from 2006, which means there may be several issues with how addons work on it.

author: Pepesmite
summary: The shipped WoW.exe is deliberately modified so custom content works, which is what antivirus software flags as a trojan.
quote: There is a modified version of wow.exe in the game client, which is perceived by the protection as a trojan but is not. Modification of wow.exe is necessary for custom content to work.

author: Jamey
topic_title: Urgent Need for Enhanced Account Security
summary: Password case-insensitivity comes from the game client's login protocol and is outside the team's control.
quote: Case insensitivity is a game client issue, a portion we do not control.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Third-party addons are not maintained or supported by staff; a list of addons tested on the server is published separately.
quote: We do not support this addon and do not maintain it. Please try to ask your question to the author of the addon ... All addons that are tested on our server you can find here

author: Torta
topic_title: Turtle WoW 2.0 — Powered by Unreal Engine 5
summary: Turtle WoW 2.0 announced: the vanilla client replicated in Unreal Engine 5 by a second team, Council of Tirisfal, worked on for about eighteen months and built for the Turtle core with custom content supported out of the box.
quote: we started our collaboration with the second development team known as Council of Tirisfal. Today, we're excited to present the first look at our special development: Turtle WoW 2.0 — the Vanilla WoW client fully replicated in Unreal Engine 5.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Turtle WoW 2.0 — Powered by Unreal Engine 5
summary: 2.0 FAQ: Legacy Mode targeted at 99.9% of current players, no move past Mysteries of Azeroth, a transitional period with both clients before the old one is retired, and post-release accessibility work including text-to-speech and non-colour indicators.
quote: Does this mean Turtle is going past vanilla+ into newer expansions? No, we'll be staying on Mysteries of Azeroth! ... There will be a transitional period where you can play with both the old and new clients. Eventually, the new client will become necessary.

author: Torta
summary: Labor & Legacy added extra darker skin tones for Dwarves, High Elves, Gnomes and Night Elves, styled to match the original art.
quote: In the Labor & Legacy patch, we have added additional darker skin color tones for Dwarves, High Elves, Gnomes and even Night Elves. The original version had less. It went mostly unnoticed because we tried our best to match the original style.

author: Torta
summary: New skin tones were added for Dwarves, High Elves, Gnomes and Night Elves in Labor & Legacy and kept within each race's plausible range rather than cross-applied between races.
quote: The new skin tones are within the acceptable range of what orcs can have — yeah, sure, and the same goes for any other race. That's the approach.

author: Akalix
summary: The community HD patch's incompatibility with the official client is localised to Patch-A and Patch-Z spell effects.
quote: The incompatibility in the HD Patch is in Patch-A and Patch-Z. The problem stems from the Spell Effects. Other parts are not heavily problematic.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Any talent calculators available for the upcoming 2.0 patch?
summary: Turtle WoW 2.0 is a client engine migration rather than a content patch.
quote: Turtle WoW 2.0 is a client engine migration, not a content patch.

author: Torta
summary: Official launcher ships with automated WDB clearing, addon management, and default support for VanillaFixes, Nampower and DXVK.
quote: Automated WDB clearing ... Addon Management (One-button updates!) ... Default support for VanillaFixes, Nampower, and DXVK.

author: Akalix
summary: Achievements were planned for the 2.0 client.
quote: Achievements are planned for the 2.0 client.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Linux and Mac are not officially supported; help comes only from guides and Discord channels.
quote: We do not officially support running the game client on Linux or Mac.

author: Sleeptime
summary: Barbershops were disabled because they crashed the realms; return planned once fixed.
quote: Last time they were in, they kept crashing the realms. Once the issue is fixed, we'll bring them back

author: Akalix
summary: 'Naked' custom character skins are an unintended byproduct of NPC-derived skins that never had undergarments modelled; a fix needs a client patch.
quote: It was never intended to have "naked" character models, it's just a byproduct of the skins coming from NPCs which never had undergarments modeled as they'd always have on armor.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Known causes of client error #124: the HD mod, SuperWoW, VanillaFixes/VanillaTweaks, memory-leaking addons, excessive launcher tweak values and weak integrated graphics; crash logs are not analysed by staff.
quote: Error #124 can occur due to several reasons, including: 1. Having HD mod installed 2. Using Super WoW 3. Having Vanilla Fixes or Vanilla Tweaks installed 4. Running addons that cause memory leaks

author: Bowser
topic_title: Turtle WoW 2.0 & Unreal Azeroth — Technical Report
summary: 2.0 status update: Windows client aimed at December 2025, realms hold about 11k players without lag (SEA hit 13k before world update load forced queues), existing realms and characters unaffected because the change is client-side, and flying mounts explicitly not planned.
quote: our current realms support up to 11k players each without any lag. We did have a SEA realms hitting 13k players, but the world update load was too high ... While technically possible to enable flying mounts with real flying physics, it's not planned. It would change the game too much

author: Torta
summary: The small client patch delivered through the launcher is mandatory for cross-faction battlegrounds.
quote: The update through the launcher is required.

author: Torta
summary: A launcher-delivered client patch (a Faction.dbc fix) is required to play cross-faction battlegrounds.
quote: It delivers a minor fix for the Faction.dbc bug that could cause issues when participating in cross‑faction battlegrounds. The fix will also be included in the larger Nightmares of Ursol update, but because this patch is tiny and lightweight we expect players to obtain it via the launcher.

author: Torta
summary: The Turtle WoW 2.0 Unreal Engine 5 client was permanently discontinued on 19 December 2025, ending the development agreement with Unreal Azeroth.
quote: Effective today, our development agreement with Unreal Azeroth for the production of the Turtle WoW 2.0 client is permanently discontinued.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Naxxramas is meant to stay unscaled as vanilla's absolute end, requiring a full army; future custom raids were argued to stay unscaled too.
quote: No scaling, Naxxramas is intended to be the absolute end to Vanilla ... The Dread Necropolis should require a true army to conquer, not a small strike force.

author: Gheor
topic_title: New Dungeons and Raids for Future patches
summary: Northrend was never announced and Outland is the intended endpoint; Silvermoon and Karazhan were the confirmed Episode 2 raids, with Deatholme planned as an outdoor questing hub.
quote: Northrend was never announced, Outland is the end for now ... Silvermoon is confirmed to be a raid for Episode 2. The other raid to be confirmed is Karazhan.

author: Akalix
summary: Old raid encounters are not retuned for high-end raiders because newer groups still wipe on them.
quote: Ragnaros wipes still happen in newer raiding groups--balancing the lowest end of raids for higher end raiders will cause many issues.

author: Torta
summary: Pets can no longer be sent at targets out of line of sight inside dungeons, closing an exploit that pulled bosses through gates and walls.
quote: You can no longer send your pet to attack a target that is not in line of sight inside dungeons, in order to prevent exploits that allowed you to pull bosses through closed gates or walls.

author: Torta
summary: Leaving a raid while in combat was disabled to stop groups re-killing the first boss repeatedly.
quote: It's no longer allowed to leave raids while in your character is in combat. This is a measurement implemented to prevent raid groups from exploiting the first boss multiple times.

author: Torta
summary: Nightmare dragon health corrected from 1.2 million to 832,750 to match Classic values.
quote: All dragons' health has been reduced from 1.2 Million to 832,750 health. This was done due to the latter health value being the right value according to Classic.

author: Torta
summary: Scarlet Citadel is on hold, not cancelled: the upscaled vanilla Scarlet Monastery WMO proved too small for 40 players, so a new model is needed. No developer left the team.
quote: The Citadel development is on hold because we've decided to not use the upscaled Vanilla WMO of the merged Scarlet Monastery but come up with something unique and better in the future.

author: Torta
summary: The upscaled Scarlet Monastery WMO was abandoned for Scarlet Citadel because it was still too small for a 40-player raid and caused many issues.
quote: Even upscaled, it appeared to be too small for the 40-player adventure. We encountered so many issues with it, so at some point it was decided to start over with a different model.

author: Jamey
topic_title: Since we voted to remove WBs (and they have) let's tackle the rising issues of no WB raiding.
summary: Raid scaling only applies in specific situations and existed because of a shortage of endgame players; after world-buff removal the team considered altering or disabling it.
quote: Raid scaling is only enabled in specific situations ... it is something that we are actively discussing to alter or disable altogether as the main reason to have it in the first place was lack of available end-game players to do raids with.

author: Jamey
summary: Five of the six final-chamber Scholomance bosses raised from a 30% to a 100% chance to drop from the shared 20-item table.
quote: The chance for 5 of the 6 bosses in the final chambers of Scholomance to drop boss loot has been raised from 30% to 100%.

author: Akalix
summary: Summoning stones refused because they would discourage travelling the open world to dungeons.
quote: As much convenience as this would add, it would discourage players traveling the open world to venture to dungeons.

author: Torta
topic_title: A Follow-up Statement About AQ Event Relaunch
summary: Cancels the planned AQ war-effort re-run on EU for lore-consistency reasons.
quote: We have made the decision not to proceed with this plan. Taking into account both the realm's history and lore, it simply does not make sense to wage the same war twice within the storytelling of Warcraft.

author: Torta
topic_title: A Follow-up Statement About AQ Event Relaunch
summary: Scourge Invasion to become a repeating event; the open-world component is under review because of its effect on levelling Hardcore characters.
quote: The Scourge event will be turned into a repeating occasion. We're still discussing if we want to keep the open-world aspect of it, as it might have very unfortunate effects on the leveling Hardcore characters

author: Torta
summary: Soulbound raid items can only be traded to players who were inside the raid when the boss died.
quote: You can no longer trade soulbound raid items to players who were not inside the raid when the boss died.

author: Akalix
summary: Scarlet Citadel is shelved, not cancelled: model problems moved it to the backburner, not planned for 1.17 or likely 1.18.
quote: Scarlet Citadel is a concept we worked on, encountered issues with, and have moved into the "come back to it later" category.

author: Jamey
topic_title: Make Emerald Sanctum scale with player count
summary: Emerald Sanctum was never meant to scale; scaling is being dialled back generally now that population is healthy, to encourage larger social raids.
quote: ES scaling was never intended ... We've been dialing back on scaling amounts for most content since population is mostly no longer an issue. We want to encourage the social aspect of raiding by accepting more raid members.

author: Torta
summary: The 20->30 raid scaling threshold change is reverted after feedback; general scaling rules unchanged; Emerald Sanctum stays 40-man because its mechanics are built for 40.
quote: The change from 20 to 30 will be reverted in the next update. The general scaling rules will remain the same as before. The new raid, Emerald Sanctum will remain requiring 40-man as it's featuring mechanics made with 40 players in mind.

author: Akalix
summary: Tel'Abim phase plan: P1 4 months (all custom dungeons, Onyxia, MC, Lower Karazhan Halls, world bosses), P2 3 months (BWL, ZG, Emerald Sanctum, Nightmare dragons), P3 3 months (AQ), P4 Scourge Invasion + Naxxramas.
quote: Phase 1 will last 4 months, including: All new dungeons (Crescent Grove, Gilneas City, Hateforge Quarry, Karazhan Crypt, Stormwind Vault, Caverns of Time: Black Morass) ... Phase 4 will include: Scourge Invasion, Naxxramas

author: Torta
summary: Group-loot wins no longer become free-for-all when the winner's bags are full; unlooted rare-or-better items are mailed to the winner instead of being lost.
quote: Items won through group loot will no longer become free-for-all if the roll winner's bags are full. Any rare or higher quality items that are still unlooted upon the corpse despawning will be sent to the winner by mail, instead of being lost forever.

author: Torta
summary: BWL locked so Razorgore must be completed before other bosses spawn and the room cannot be left, in response to cheating software; enchant restrictions in Vagrant's Challenge stop applying at 60.
quote: Leaving Razorgore's room in BWL is no longer possible before completing the encounter ... Other bosses in BWL will now only spawn after completing the Razorgore encounter to prevent cheating.

author: Torta
summary: Legitimate trash skipping remains allowed; only boss skipping is targeted.
quote: We don't have such plans. Skipping trash isn't equivalent to skipping the bosses in the linearly designed raid, if done fair and square.

author: Torta
summary: A resurrection-based dungeon reset exploit that teleported players back to their death position in a fresh instance was fixed.
quote: Fixed a dungeon reset exploit involving resurrection that allowed players to reset the instance and then teleport to the same position where they had died within the new instance.

author: Torta
summary: Tower of Karazhan is a 40-player raid harder than Naxxramas introducing Tier 3.5, with realm-first title 'Warden of the Ley Lines' and completion title 'Bane of the Nathrezim'.
quote: This raid will feature the new Tier Set 3.5 and challenge 40 players to gameplay even more difficult than Naxxramas ... Realm First: Warden of the Ley Lines ... Raid Completion for All: Bane of the Nathrezim

author: Akalix
summary: Tel'Abim Phase 2 pulled forward to fight player attrition and to keep the PvP realm aligned with Nordanaar for future tier releases.
quote: we have seen a gradual dropoff of players over time. With this, and the complaint of "there's not enough to do," we've decided to take an aggressive approach to the attrition ... we don't want a realm to be denied access to new content when 1.17.x or 1.18 release.

author: Torta
summary: Tower of Karazhan bosses leash if kited too far.
quote: Karazhan bosses can no longer be kited and will leash if brought too far away.

author: Akalix
summary: 1.17.2 adds two new areas and two new bosses each to Deadmines (Jared Vess, Masterpiece Harvester) and Wailing Caverns (Vangros, Zandara Windhoof), with reworked early-boss loot tables.
quote: Deadmines - New Areas: Two new areas have been added, featuring a new boss in each ... Wailing Caverns - New Bosses: Vangros ... Zandara Windhoof

author: Torta
summary: The 10-minute soulbound trading window extended to blue-or-better trash loot in raids.
quote: Extended the 10-minute grace period for trading Soulbound items in raids to include loot from trash, provided the items are of rare quality (blue) or higher.

author: Reynolds
summary: Instance ownership rules reworked to stop dungeon-reset exploits; players keep their dungeon position and party status on relog; LFT groups keep group loot enforced and leaders cannot kick during active rolls.
quote: Reworked instance ownership rules to prevent exploits when resetting dungeons. You will no longer be automatically removed from the group upon logging out.

author: Akalix
summary: World bosses get a weekly loot lockout and summonable versions via world-drop quest items; summoned bosses do not affect the natural respawn timer; bosses stay in the open world, not instanced.
quote: World boss loot will have a weekly lockout similar to instances. Players will be able to find items throughout the world which will be used by quests to summon certain world bosses ... Summoned world bosses will not affect their normal respawn timer.

author: Dragunovi
summary: World bosses can be summoned and killed repeatedly, but each character is loot-eligible only on the first kill of that boss each week.
quote: Everyone can summon and kill world bosses multiple times per week, but you are eligible for loot on the first kill of a world boss every week on that character

author: Akalix
summary: The daily snowball quest replaced the Winter Veil world boss so everyone can access the loot rather than one Discord-coordinated group taking nearly every respawn.
quote: Would you prefer the old Snowball system, where it was a worldboss where all but a handful of respawns were killed by a single group on Discord? It's a replacement for everyone to have access to the loot from the world boss.

author: Akalix
summary: Karazhan 40's delay defended: complete but in QA, and shop cosmetics continue to ship because they fund the servers.
quote: it is not finished in the QA stage as we do not want to release a buggy, unbalanced mess of a raid. We will be taking our time to deliver a good raid, rather than rushing it out

author: Akalix
topic_title: Tower of Karazhan Status Update I
summary: Karazhan 40 held in QA until complete; release date to be announced at least 14 days ahead; realm-first title renamed Conqueror of Desolation.
quote: we are absolutely not willing to release the raid in an unfinished state ... the title for realm first has been changed to Conqueror of Desolation ... We will be publishing a release date alongside the Tower of Karazhan raid release trailer a minimum of 14 days prior to release.

author: Torta
summary: Tower of Karazhan opened 3 April 2025 at 1pm UTC with Tier 3.5, realm-first title Conqueror of Desolation and completion title Bane of the Nathrezim.
quote: The Tower of Karazhan's haunted upper halls will become accessible to players starting April 3rd at 1pm UTC ... Realm First: Conqueror of Desolation ... Raid Completion for All: Bane of the Nathrezim

author: Torta
summary: Two weeks after release Karazhan was tuned down: boss HP reduced, ability cooldowns increased, drop chances raised (Ephemeral Pendant 4%->10%), Anomalus requirements reduced.
quote: Increased the drop chance of Ephemeral Pendant from 4% to 10% for all Outland bosses ... Decreased HP of various boss encounters ... Increased cooldowns on abilities for Kruul, Rupturan, Chess & Mephistroth.

author: Torta
summary: The 5-instances-per-hour limit is now counted separately for dungeons and raids.
quote: The 5 instances per hour limit is now separate for dungeons and raids.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Damage of Elites in open world/instances
summary: Content is stated to be already easier than baseline vanilla and will not be made easier.
quote: Currently, content is notably easier than in a "baseline vanilla" state. We do not intend to lower difficulty further.

author: Akalix
summary: No personal loot will be added; hard-reserve pug culture is treated as a player-side problem that self-corrects, and GDKP's real problem is named as the RMT it motivates.
quote: The solution to this is not one requiring dev or support involvement -- the best solution to this is player-generated ... We have no plans to add personal loot.

author: Akalix
summary: Staff distinguish hard-reserve pugs from GDKP: GDKP was a problem because it motivated RMT, which HR runs do not.
quote: The differences between HR runs and GDKP runs are numerous, but the key detail here is that GDKP runs themselves weren't the "big" issue -- it was RMT that they motivated. This isn't the case with HR runs.

author: Torta
summary: 1.18.1 adds a new BWL boss, zone extension and layout changes; Ambershire's BWL release was pushed to 1.18.1 by community poll so the fresh realm's first kills would be on the updated version.
quote: In the next Patch 1.18.1 we have new content for BWL, a new boss, zone extension, and some layout changes! We didn't want to release BWL without it on a fresh realm where guilds are still competing in the raiding scene for the first kill the old version of the dungeon.

author: Shadowsong
summary: Loot from non-boss enemies became tradable within a 10-minute window; Paladin and Shaman Tier 2 leggings had a lower drop chance than other classes and were fixed.
quote: Loot is now tradable from non-boss enemies within a 10 minute period ... Fixed Paladin and Shaman Tier 2 leggings having lower chance to drop than those of other classes.

author: Torta
summary: After the shutdown announcement raid scaling was enabled on all raids and minimum thresholds lowered: 20-player raids to 8 players, 40-player raids to 16.
quote: Raid Scaling is now active on all raids. All 20-player raids now have a minimum scaling threshold of 8 players (down from 12). All 40-player raids now have a minimum scaling threshold of 16 players (down from 20).

author: Torta
summary: Major blizzlike features such as the auction house will not be removed.
quote: This is an interesting concept but we don't plan to remove major blizzlike features. Remember, this server is also giving PvE players a new home who rely on the Auction House.

author: Torta
summary: Convenience shop items (portable mailbox, auction house) exist because players wanted functional rather than purely cosmetic rewards; the team frames them as non-gamebreaking and non-p2w.
quote: we tried to find non-gamebreaking, non-p2w options for our shop, players want functional items, not just plain cosmetic items. Most of our new features are free and available for everyone.

author: Torta
summary: After feedback the portable mailbox was pulled from the shop and the repair bot stopped selling reagents; the portable auction house was kept.
quote: I'll remove portable mailbox from the shop, and repair bot will no longer sell reagents. I wish AH bot to stay tho

author: Torta
summary: A goblin gambling house in Orgrimmar was planned for the expansion.
quote: We're going to have a gambling house in Orgrimmar in the expansion.

author: Torta
summary: Payment options are constrained because the project is not a company and cannot use normal payment or banking channels.
quote: We are not a company and normal payment systems are not available for us. Nor the normal bank transactions due to privacy concerns.

author: Torta
topic_title: Remove Turtle Mounts, Azure Drakes and Cloud Pets
summary: Why there is a cosmetic shop rather than a subscription: a sub model would collapse the player base and invite legal action.
quote: There is absolutely no way a private server can survive with a subscription model ... Also, lawsuit would be immediately at my door. Blizzard is tolerating a lot of things, but this would be just too much.

author: Torta
summary: Nothing related to Hardcore Mode will be sold or changed through the donation shop.
quote: Sorry, we are not planning to change anything related to Hardcore Mode.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Maybe add Scarab Lord Mount as price of spectral tiger?
summary: The Scarab Lord mount will not be sold, out of respect for players who earned it; it is unobtainable now that the gates are open.
quote: we have people who grinded out the Scarab Lord questline back in the day, and it would be quite a bummer to see people who paid to skip the work.

author: Torta
summary: Donation tokens spent on a hardcore character are automatically refunded when it dies, but not if it is deleted while alive.
quote: If your hardcore character dies, tokens will automatically return onto your balance. If you delete it while it's still alive, it will not happen

author: Dragunovi
summary: An hourly cap on outgoing letters was added, understood by staff as an anti-gold-seller measure.
quote: I would guess its gold sellers spamming mail adverts to players.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Characters below level 10 are not retained on deletion, so tokens spent on them cannot be recovered; deletion requires typing the character name.
quote: we do not store data on characters below level 10. If you delete a character, they are lost.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Guards spawning on a repeatable shellfish-trap gold farm are intended, added in anticipation of the exploit.
quote: It's not a bug. We anticipated this exploit before it became a popular source of revenue. The guards spawn as they should.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Direct PayPal transfers are not accepted for donations because of privacy concerns; donors must use the GamePoints option in the donation portal.
quote: We do not directly accept PayPal donations due to privacy concerns.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: Is Backpack: 28 slots shared across account?
summary: Shop items bind to the character; refunds require both that under 48 hours have passed and that the character is not Hardcore.
quote: All items are tied to a character ... You can issue a refund through the ticket system if 2 conditions are met: 1. 48 hours have not passed since the purchase. 2. Your character is not HC

author: Jamey
topic_title: Nerfing ZG croc farm is a horrible decision
summary: Stated principle: high-end instanced farming should need two or more players, and solo single-class farming should not beat mixed group farming.
quote: High-end instanced farming should ideally require a team of at least two or more players and solo farming with a single class should not surpass the efficiency of group farming with multiple players of different classes. This is to encourage social interaction within the community

author: Pepesmite
summary: Undelivered mail returns to the sender within 30 days; staff never restore or re-send mail and treat addressing as the player's responsibility.
quote: If the mail did not reach the recipient, it is returned to the sender within 30 days ... we do not return mail or restore mail.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Please restore the race/faction change service
summary: The race change service was intended to return (it did, in June 2024).
quote: We plan to re-add the racechange feature in the future.

author: Akalix
summary: Donations start at 1 euro; the scaling bonus begins at 30 euro, adding 2.5% extra tokens per 10 euro up to 40%.
quote: We have a scaling milestone donation system that starts from 30 Euro. Your support will be rewarded with a bonus of extra 2.5% tokens every 10 Euro, that scales up to a maximum of 40%.

author: Akalix
summary: GDKP is permanently banned because it is inseparable from RMT.
quote: we will never allow RMT, and with that, we will never allow GDKP, as they go hand-in-hand.

author: Akalix
summary: Listed elixirs/protection potions persist through death in dungeon and raid environments to cut raiding consumable costs.
quote: Starting after our 2024 — January 31 maintenance, the following effects will persist through death in Dungeon & Raid environments

author: Akalix
topic_title: Economy Update — GDKP, TDKP, and Turtle WoW
summary: TDKP ('tithe-DKP', items instead of gold) also banned; 2-week bans for participants, permanent for organizers and RMTers.
quote: GDKP raids, where groups auction bind-on-pickup or bind-on-equip items for gold, real money, or similar in-game currencies (including valuable items), may NOT be created, promoted or attended ... will be issuing 2 week bans to any participants, with organizers and blatant RMTers receiving permanent bans.

author: Jamey
summary: Omission of Winterfall Firewater, Dreamtonic, jujus, alcohols and foods from the persist-through-death list is intentional.
quote: Yes, intended.

author: Akalix
summary: No compensation for players whose stockpiled materials lost value after an economy change.
quote: No. If you opt to not sell when demand is high, and speculate that it will go higher, you cannot blame the market when demand drops.

author: Torta
summary: New character customizations are not donation-shop exclusive.
quote: No.

author: Jamey
summary: Dire Maul East lasher farming was by far the largest raw-gold faucet and was nerfed to bring it in line.
quote: DME is by FAR the biggest source of raw gold, the number 2 spot is very far off. We're changing this method to bring it more in line with others while also alleviating problems with the cost of endgame consumables.

author: Akalix
summary: After criticism of the random-reward shop egg, odds were published and players can request an account-level block on the item.
quote: the odds can now be seen within the spoilered message below the original post. Players may also ticket support to have a restriction placed on their account to prevent access to this shop item.

author: Torta
summary: Free appearance-change tokens are only granted when a change forces itself on existing characters.
quote: No, we usually only give out tokens for free when there's no way to avoid changing existing players' characters.

author: Torta
summary: Almost the entire ~100-200 person team is paid from donation-shop revenue; recruitment of new modders was stopped for cost reasons; if funding fails, development stalls but the server keeps running and pay-to-win is still excluded.
quote: for many years now, everyone here has been paid ... it's safe to say that 99% of our team receives compensation ... even then, we won't resort to introducing pay-to-win elements. The worst-case scenario if we no longer have funding is that development will stall, but the server will continue to run.

author: Torta
summary: No further RNG shop features like the Noblegarden egg are planned; SEA revenue is stated to cover general project development while EU/NA only partly sustains itself.
quote: We have no plans to introduce features such as the egg in the future ... SEA is not only supporting its own staff and network infrastructure ... but is also covering general project development costs for the entire community

author: Akalix
topic_title: Please sell PvP gear in shop
summary: No paid progression will be sold.
quote: We do not plan to add paid-progression.

author: Akalix
summary: GDKP was banned outright rather than policed because it is directly linked to gold buying and replaces earned progression with afforded progression; every other loot system is allowed as long as progression is not sold.
quote: we opted to ban GDKP outright rather than fight the losing battle of preventing RMT in a setting where the idea of earned progression is replaced by "affording" progression. Players are free to use whatever loot system they wish, so long as progression isn't being sold.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Price for new stables is way too high
summary: The 250-gold extra hunter stable slots are deliberately expensive gold sinks and non-essential.
quote: These serve as gold sinks. They are completely non-essential. Price is intentionally high.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: Requesting assistance, race change, can no longer use donation skin
summary: Race- or faction-locked shop items become unusable after a race change and are only refundable within 48 hours of purchase.
quote: If from the moment of purchase more than 48 hours have passed and you decide to change race or faction, be prepared that the unique items will remain with you, but you will not be able to use them.

author: Torta
summary: Shellcoin items were made Bind on Pickup specifically to prevent RMT.
quote: Shellcoin items are now Bind on Pickup to prevent RMT activities.

author: Sleeptime
summary: Race change returned via the donation shop and also changes faction (except on Tel'Abim).
quote: Race changes are now available through the donation shop—you can change both your race and faction.

author: Hyundef
topic_title: Why aren't donation rewards account bound?
summary: Tokens are account-wide but shop items are character-bound, matching vanilla's lack of account-bound items and supporting server funding.
quote: Also follows suit with how things were in vanilla/classic, too. Account-bound items weren't a thing, it was all character-bound.

author: Torta
summary: Hardcore mode selection was limited to level 10 and below; riding skill was ruled out as a hardcore reward.
quote: Hardcore mode will now only be available up until level 10. If you do not select it by this level, you will remain on normal mode without the option to change ... Riding Skill will not return as hardcore reward.

author: Torta
summary: Turtle/Slow & Steady mode rules: 50% reduced creature XP, quest XP unchanged, 5% XP loss on death outside BG/PvP. Later edit halves dungeon creature XP citing donation-system exploitation via dungeon speed-leveling.
quote: XP from creature kills — both in the open world and dungeons is reduced by 50%. Quest XP stays the same ... Additionally, with the next patch, XP gained from creature kills in dungeons will be halved. This change comes in response to a growing number of players using dungeon speed-leveling to exploit the donation system.

author: Torta
topic_title: I'd like to have a Glyph that forbids getting any rested XP as long as I have it in the Keyring.
summary: Glyph of Exhaustion prevents all rested bonus while it is on the keyring.
quote: Starting this Wednesday'the Glyph of Exhaustion will prevent you from getting rested bonus ever, while you have it on your keyring.

author: Torta
summary: XP loss on death in Turtle Mode can never cause a level loss.
quote: De-leveling isn't possible.

author: Torta
summary: Reason for the Turtle Mode XP changes: rested XP from tents let players level at effectively x1, defeating the challenge; the compromise preserves the social 'Tent Party'.
quote: Hardcore Mode was not Hardcore at all. Players still could use rested XP from tents and level on x1 instead of going through hardcore adventure. We didn't want to close an important and fun social interaction such as "Tent Party" for Hardcore players so I had to come up with a compromise.

author: Torta
summary: Refuses to split hardcore into multiple sub-modes; suggests Glyph of Exhaustion for a slower pace.
quote: Sorry but I find it's very confusing to have multiply hardcore modes, not worth time implementing. For a slower mode you can get "Glyph of Exhaustion" tho :)

author: Torta
summary: Mortal/Hardcore restrictions as designed: no auction house, trade, grouping and mail only with other Mortal characters.
quote: Mortal characters will not be able to use Auction House. Mortal characters will be able to trade only with other Mortal characters ... send and receive mails only from other Mortal characters.

author: Torta
summary: Slow & Steady renamed to Turtle Mode to disambiguate from the upcoming Mortal/Hardcore mode.
quote: We are going to rename this mode to the Turtle Mode in order to minimize the confusion between upcoming Mortal/Hardcore Mode and our present Hardcore Mode.

author: Torta
summary: Canonical Hardcore Mode announcement: toggle at character creation, Still Alive title while levelling, Immortal title plus tabard and Immortal Champion's Charger at 60, and an explicit no-restoration rule covering connection problems and bugs.
quote: When your character dies, the game ends for you ... we will not restore any deceased hardcore characters for any reason including connection problems, bugs, global warming, your little sister, or any other reason whatsoever.

author: Torta
summary: At level 60 the hardcore restrictions lift entirely and the character plays like any other.
quote: Once you're 60, you can play the game as any other player: use AH, mail, die and raid.

author: Gheor
summary: Hardcore deliberately rewards only a title and a mount at 60; incremental rewards every ten levels would defeat the point. Softer death penalties are rejected as not hardcore at all.
quote: the title and the mount is all you get because if you were to obtain something every ten level it would defeat the purpose of hardcore gameplay, there is always the optional Turtle Mode.

author: Torta
topic_title: Leaderboard of mobs with the highest HC player kill count
summary: Hardcore death records store coordinates and zone but not the killing creature's ID, so a killer leaderboard is not possible retroactively.
quote: we don't have records on already happened deaths. We log the coordinates and zones, but not the creature ID.

author: Torta
summary: Hardcore rules are deliberately frozen so every hardcore player levels under identical conditions and the mode cannot be accused of getting easier over time.
quote: we want every HC to level in similar conditions and with the same rules, w/o opening a window for speculations that the mode is becoming less challenging over time.

author: Torta
summary: Hardcore characters can be PvP-flagged; avoiding it is the player's responsibility. Specific traps named: attacking PvP-flagged NPCs, buffing or healing flagged players.
quote: We never said PvP would not be available, it was your task to ensure you aren't flagged ... do not attack PvP-flagged NPCs or do not buff or heal players with the green names.

author: Torta
summary: Temporary gravestones spawn where hardcore characters die; they will never carry loot or chests.
quote: There'll be now temporary gravestones spawned upon the death of our Hardcore characters starting this Wednesday :) We're not planning to add any chests or loot to the tombstones

author: Akalix
summary: Splitting hardcore onto its own realm is refused because it would cut player interaction; competing for tags is treated as a normal part of the game.
quote: We do not have any plans to be splitting servers, as it would cause a dramatic and noticeable decrease in the number of player interactions. Fighting (and cooperating) for tags is a basic part of the game.

author: Akalix
summary: Detailed refusal of a hardcore-only realm: ~12,000 hardcore characters, both realms would look empty, chats would thin out, extra server resources needed, and players would be torn from guilds at level 60.
quote: There are nearly 12,000 HC characters ... segregating them would do little good for the server while causing many issues. Both realms would look much less populated, chats would be less active, we would need to dedicate more server resources

author: Akalix
topic_title: Armored Azure Drake and other dragons...
summary: Hardcore mounts and titles are per-character, not account-wide.
quote: Mounts and titles are character-unique. If you want Immortal on multiple characters, you'll have to level them up individually.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Hold a vote on HC graves
summary: Hardcore graves require level 10 and use a scaling lifetime: higher-level graves persist longer, low-level ones vanish faster.
quote: These changes include requiring level 10 for a grave to spawn, and implementing a scaling system for higher level graves to last longer and low level graves to disappear faster.

author: Torta
summary: Guard aggro distance lowered against players not flagged for PvP, to avoid accidental deaths.
quote: Aggro distance of Guards is now lower against players who are not flagged for PvP. This should avoid accidental deaths.

author: Akalix
topic_title: How to make Tents better and more immersive
summary: Logging out under a tent gives no rested XP, while logging out in an inn does — the pre-1.18.1 distinction.
quote: the inns do still serve a purpose--if you log out under a tent, you do not gain any rested experience, while you do in an inn.

author: Torta
summary: Enemy civilians no longer summon guards when a Hardcore player approaches, to avoid accidental permadeaths.
quote: Enemy civilians will no longer summon guards when a hardcore player approaches them.

author: Torta
summary: Group XP formulas corrected when members carry XP-altering challenges such as War Mode or Slow and Steady; hardcore characters get a no-aggro grace period after an unexpected restart or crash.
quote: Fixed the XP formulas for grouped members if one or more members have XP altering challenges such as War Mode or Slow and Steady. HCs now don't aggro hostile NPCs upon getting close for a short duration after logging in if there has been a recent unexpected server restart/crash.

author: Akalix
topic_title: A warning disclaimer to HC challenge quest
summary: The hardcore challenge quest text already states permadeath explicitly and that support will not revive anyone.
quote: It does say directly in the quest, "Should you die, you shall not return again. Customer service will not revive a fallen hero for any reason."

author: Akalix
topic_title: Died purely due to server DC
summary: Deaths from crashes and disconnects are treated as part of the hardcore risk, with prior Discord warnings during instability; no restoration ever.
quote: Crashes definitely suck. Deaths that happen outside of your control definitely suck. But that's the risk of Hardcore ... Unfortunately, we never will restore a hardcore death.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Delete buff from tents for HC characters
summary: Tents will not be removed for hardcore players (2023 position; the tent rested bonus was later reworked in 1.18.1).
quote: We currently do not plan to remove Tents from HC players.

author: Moriena
summary: Staff correction: hardcore is not the primary playstyle on Turtle WoW.
quote: Sorry to disappoint you, but Hardcore is in fact Not the primary playstyle of Turtle WoW.

author: Torta
summary: Vagrant's Endeavor restricts equippable items but enchanting is not restricted, pending feedback.
quote: As of now we don't plan to restrict enchanting for Vagrant's Endeavor. It might change depending on feedback.

author: Akalix
summary: Hardcore characters will never be revived under any circumstance; a resurrection policy is called a slippery slope and a support burden.
quote: We will never revive a fallen hardcore character, under any circumstances. It's a slippery slope we are unwilling to open ourselves up to

author: Akalix
summary: Inferno (HC60) design: level 55 attunement questline opts a Hardcore character into permanent max-level hardcore; Inferno players gain guild bank access, non-Inferno Hardcore players do not.
quote: Upon reaching level 55, an attunement questline will be unlocked which allows players to opt-in to Inferno Mode ... Players with the [Inferno] gamemode will now be able to purchase and access Guild Bank tabs. Hardcore players without [Inferno] gamemode will still be unable to access Guild Banks.

author: Akalix
summary: Death in PvP counts as a hardcore death in Challenger/Inferno.
quote: Challenger is treated as an extension of the Hardcore gamemode, meaning any death = done.

author: Akalix
summary: No appeals for hardcore deaths, including deaths to lag.
quote: We do not plan to add appeals. Death = Death.

author: Akalix
summary: Reasons for retiring the <Still Alive> mega-guild in favour of a [Hardcore] channel and title: GM moderation limits, suppressed community building, accidental /gquit locking players out.
quote: GMs need to be in multiple public Guilds at the same time to moderate them. This is not possible. ... Players who /gquit at level 1 from spam immediately lose all access to groups and trades. ... A guild of 10,000 people is very departed from this concept.

author: Akalix
summary: Leaving the Hardcore ecosystem (becoming Immortal) is one-way.
quote: If you ever become Immortal, and leave the Hardcore ecosystem, you will not be able to reenter it. Once you're out of HC, you're out.

author: Akalix
summary: Rejects any resurrection/phylactery item for hardcore characters.
quote: Death is permanent. We will not be adding this feature, as it is against the nature of the Hardcore challenge.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Canonical hardcore restriction list: trading and grouping only with other hardcore characters within 5 levels, no auction house, mail without attachments.
quote: You will be able to trade items and gold only with other Hardcore characters as long as the difference between your levels isn't higher than 5 ... Hardcore characters can not trade, nor buy on Auction House. Hardcore characters can use mail, but with no attachments.

author: Akalix
summary: Hardcore death messages below level 40 are hidden unless opted in with .hcmessages; hardcore players get protection when the server is overloaded.
quote: You will no longer see hardcore messages about players below level 40, unless you opt in using the .hcmessages command ... Added protection for Hardcore players when the server is overloaded.

author: Torta
summary: Glyph of Exhaustion no longer accrues rested bonus while offline.
quote: Glyph of Exhaustion will no longer grant rested bonus while the player is offline.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Hardcore players may only be helped by members of their own (hardcore) group; outside help is reported and warned, with each case reviewed.
quote: in the HC Challenge, help is only permitted from members within your own group.

author: Akalix
summary: No client-side confirmation dialog will be added for the hardcore quest; players are told to read the quest text.
quote: We do not plan to invest resources into client modding for this menu -- read the quest before you turn it in

author: Akalix
summary: Inferno was designed by the poster around escalating danger requiring grouped hardcore dungeon and raid play; the accusation that difficulty exists to sell shop items is rejected, and shop items are refunded on death.
quote: The mode was designed around battling increasingly dangerous foes, which in endgame, requires grouping with other hardcores to venture into dungeons and raids ... all items are refunded on death.

author: Cherrypie
summary: Correcting a GM error: a hardcore character may only be helped by another hardcore character within the 5-level grouping window.
quote: You are only allowed to assist a HC character if you are another HC character that can group up with the player. Grouping in hardcore is up to 5 level difference.

author: Torta
summary: Dying on a Hardcore character no longer removes it from its guild; the extra Sparkwater barber was removed and per-race barbers are not planned.
quote: Dying during Hardcore Challenge will no longer remove you from your guild ... No other races have their own barber available, and we aren't planning on adding them.

author: Torta
