summary: The Grand Boaring Adventure challenge starts from a Glyph Master and rewards a unique boar mount and the title The Hambringer at 60.
quote: The glyph to start the challenge is obtainable through your local Glyph Master. Reaching level 60 in this challenge will grant your character a unique boar mount and the title of The Hambringer.

author: Torta
summary: Level One Lunatic challenge design: four titles (10,000 HKs, Exalted with a faction, Arena Master trinket, 100 quests), started at any Glyph Scribe; chat is normally locked below level 5 as anti-spam, but Lunatics unlock it with 30 quests and 10 hours played, plus a /lunatic channel.
quote: By default, new characters on Turtle WoW cannot speak until they reach level 5 to prevent spam bots. However, Lunatics who complete 30 quests at level 1 and spend at least 10 hours in-game will unlock chat privileges!

author: Torta
summary: A race change resets the completed-quest counter used for the Lunatic 100-quest title.
quote: Changing your race will reset your completed quest count, and it's entirely possible to complete 100+ quests through normal gameplay.

author: Bowser
topic_title: Seeking a Fair Solution for Server Crash HC Deaths
summary: Multiple failsafes exist against crash-caused hardcore deaths and more were promised, but no resurrection policy.
quote: We already have multiple failsafes in place, but we're always looking to improve.

author: Akalix
summary: The Inferno Mode unlock questline was reworked so eternal mortality no longer requires clearing multiple high-level dungeons.
quote: The questline to unlock Inferno Mode has been reworked and grants eternal mortality without having to clear multiple high level dungeons.

author: Sleeptime
summary: A character cannot be reverted to level 59 to re-enter the hardcore ecosystem.
quote: Unfortunately, it's not possible to revert your character back to level 59.

author: Sleeptime
topic_title: Is there a way to turn off Warmode once you turn it on? (Serious)
summary: Glyph Masters and the Mysterious Stranger were removed once challenges became selectable at character creation; War Mode is the only challenge that can be turned off, at a Battlemaster.
quote: the Glyph Masters and the Mysterious Stranger have been removed, as challenges can now be started directly from the character creation menu. At the moment, other challenges CANNOT be disabled. War Mode is the only exception.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Enable BG and arena for Hardcore alone
summary: Hardcore-only battlegrounds and arenas are refused as bug-prone and contrary to the one-life theme.
quote: we do not intend to add BGs/Arenas for Hardcore, as it opens the door to too many bugs and is contradictory to the "one life" theme of the gamemode.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: Please help! Accidentally activated a challenge that disables resting — it ruined the game for me!
summary: Challenges cannot be cancelled; when the glyph system was removed, glyphs already owned were deliberately left functional as legacy items, so an old glyph can still start a challenge.
quote: While we removed the glyph system itself, any purchased glyphs that players already owned were left intact and remain functional. We deliberately chose not to take away acquired glyphs from players, leaving them as legacy items.

author: Torta
summary: Halving dungeon creature XP in Slow & Steady defended as long overdue: the challenge exists so players experience the content rather than skip it.
quote: This change was long overdue. There's nothing dishonest about this design choice: we've created a great amount of new content, and we want players to actually experience it, not just skip everything on the rush to level 60.

author: Torta
summary: Open-world creatures with Mind Control now avoid targeting Hardcore players to prevent griefing; PvP damage reduction does not apply when a participant is mind-controlled; illusions banned in battlegrounds.
quote: Open-world creatures with Mind Control abilities will now avoid targeting Hardcore players, preventing griefing ... Illusions can no longer be used inside battlegrounds.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Slow & Steady places no trading or grouping restrictions on the character; the only catch is that it cannot be switched off.
quote: This challenge does not have any restrictions for the character. The only thing is that you will not be able to disable this challenge if you realise halfway through that it is not suitable for you.

author: Torta
summary: A request to allow Lunatic characters to leave level 1 is refused; the tooltip fix requires a client update.
quote: So in this case, I'm taking the "you think you do, but you don't" stance.

author: Torta
summary: 1.18.1 moves rested XP from tents to taverns worldwide: a tavern now gives roughly the pre-1.18.1 tent rate, tents give a partial bonus, and offline tavern rested gain is unchanged. Reason: taverns fit the fiction better and the capital-gate tent camps had become a mess.
quote: Logically, a cozy tavern feels way better for a break than a tent out in the woods. The tents at Stormwind and Orgrimmar's gates have been a mess for ages ... you can now get the same rested XP bonus wherever there's a tavern in the world ... Tents in 1.18.1 will act like the new taverns but won't give you the full rested bonus

author: Torta
summary: The rested bonus value was cut deliberately so the effective XP rate is not permanently doubled, while accessibility was widened to preserve immersion instead of deleting tents.
quote: make the rested bonus more accessible worldwide and revitalize the taverns, but nerf rested bonus actual value so XP rate isn't permanently doubled in the game.

author: Sleeptime
topic_title: Server crash while playing on my hc character
summary: Characters are not teleported to safety on a crash, as that would undermine the challenge.
quote: we do not summon characters back to "safe places" as doing so would go against the very essence of the challenge

author: Torta
summary: City guard dressing boxes are roleplay outfits with no combat stats, sold at Friendly reputation.
quote: The provided items are roleplay outfits and don't have any battle stats.

author: Torta
summary: Transmog design: Fashion Coin currency from a weekly repeatable, same-armor-type restriction, reset is free; custom guild sets not transmoggable is a bug.
quote: Right now modifications are limited to the same armor type. We are considering removing this limitation at a later point if nothing speaks against it. Some of the custom guild sets are not available for transmogrification, that's a bug which will be fixed in the future.

author: Torta
summary: Portable Meeting Stones were originally intended as transport to RP hubs; because those hubs went unused, the free teleport was replaced by a reagent-consuming wormhole-style device with a cooldown and cost.
quote: Initially Portable Meetings Stones were meant as a quick transport to the active locations for role-playing interactions. However, these locations are never really crowded or really used for anything.

author: Torta
summary: Distinction drawn between acceptable and unacceptable teleports: zone-bound, lore-justified transports are fine; an inventory-bound free teleport is not.
quote: The transports you mention are bond to a zone, and also their existence is justified in the lore ... not to the player's inventory. City Protector's Scrolls can be used only by 8 people in total

author: Torta
summary: Main-hand vs one-hand weapons cannot be transmogged into each other; not deliberate but accepted.
quote: It was not planned, but I see no problems with it.

author: Torta
summary: Transmog does not let you transfer/trade an appearance onto a tradeable item; not possible.
quote: Hello :) No, it's not possible!

author: Torta
summary: Blood/High Elf illusion rewards removed because the actual High Elf race was coming; existing copies grandfathered.
quote: Blood / High Elf illusions have been removed because we're getting closer to the introduction of the real High Elf race. However, you won't lose this item if already have it.

author: Torta
topic_title: Fashionist gone killed Turtle spirit. Fix needed ASAP
summary: Transmog was pulled offline in late 2020 because it was heavily broken, including riding skill corruption and armor-type equip failures.
quote: Transmog system is heavily broken and will be returned only after fixing all known issues.

author: Torta
topic_title: Fashionist gone killed Turtle spirit. Fix needed ASAP
summary: Transmog changes were breaking the client itself: riding skill inflating and armor classes becoming unequippable.
quote: It does appear only on tooltip, however, some changes are actually breaking the client. Like: Riding Skill goes up to insane numbers or you can't equip Cloth or Mail armor.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Turtle's stat-budget table for custom items: 1% Dodge = 11.5, 1% Parry = 15.65 (because of parry haste), 1% Block = 5.65, 1% Melee Crit = 14, 1% Spell Crit = 11.3, 1% Melee Hit = 9.55, 1% Spell Hit = 11, +1 Weapon Skill assumed 3.
quote: %1 Dodge is equal to 11.5 stat budget. %1 Parry is equal to 15.65 stat budget ... %1 Block is equal to 5.65 ... %1 Melee Critical Chance is equal to 14 ... %1 Spell Critical Chance is equal to 11.3 ... %1 Melee Hit Chance is equal to 9.55

author: Gheor
summary: No uncorrupted Ashbringer; a new artifact item class is rejected.
quote: No Ashbringer, you already have the Corrupted version ... Artifacts were a mistake, making a new item class would be one too at least in my perspective.

author: Gheor
summary: Shop items are explicitly non-canon vanity items and do not establish lore.
quote: Cataclysm retcon lore, and the shop items are not canon, they are just vanity items.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Itemization philosophy: preserve the vanilla thrill of a good drop while buffing items so weak they are always disenchanted, especially crafted gear that raid drops immediately obsolete.
quote: Unique item design is one of the strongest parts of Vanilla ... Even if we want to preserve this feeling there are items that are too weak for their qualities, that end up sharded whenever they drop. This is very prevelant on crafted items too

author: Torta
topic_title: Armored Azure Drake and other dragons...
summary: The Armored Azure Drake was replaced because dragons are too large for a world without flying, and most community-suggested mounts are impossible to port to the vanilla client; the Karazhan Horse was chosen as least lore-breaking.
quote: We couldn't let players keep dragons: seeing so many people on them walking in Stormwind, Orgrimmar, or other cities, totally blocking the view ... the majority of suggested mounts are impossible to port in the Vanilla client

author: Torta
topic_title: Armored Azure Drake and other dragons...
summary: The Azure Drake spell was removed from the client in 1.16.1 and cannot be restored until re-added in 1.16.4.
quote: The spell was removed from the client altogether in 1.16.1, however, we'll add it back in 1.16.4 if the decision will be in favor of letting old HC to claim it back. Currently, it's impossible to restore, even if we wanted to.

author: Akalix
summary: Titles are reserved for major achievements such as legendaries; not for quest chains.
quote: Titles are reserved for extremely significant achievements, such as wielding a Legendary.

author: Torta
topic_title: Armored Azure Drake and other dragons...
summary: Hardcore mounts can be added to the collection without the riding skill requirement, but mount speed still scales with riding skill.
quote: You still need Riding Skill in general on level 60 to ride faster. The mounts will scale with the Riding skill, nothing is stolen from you.

author: Torta
summary: Buyback persists across logout and destroyed blue-or-better items can be repurchased from Gaston the trash collector, replacing GM restoration tickets.
quote: You can now buy back blue or higher quality items you've destroyed from a special vendor. No need to bother the Game Masters with tickets about item restorations! Seek out Gaston the trash collector in cities.

author: Akalix
summary: Shop race skins (Dark Iron Dwarf, Mag'har Orc and so on) are permanent on the character, through life, death and combat.
quote: The skins (such as Dark Iron Dwarf, Mag'Har Orc, etc) are permanently applied to your character. Life, death, combat--it's always there.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Turtle adds custom stats to vanilla itemization: Haste (1.16.0), Meditation (1.16.0) and Armor Penetration (1.16.1), with the wording used on items.
quote: 1.16.0: Haste: You can find this effect listed as "Increases your attack and casting speed by X%." ... 1.16.0: Meditation ... "Allows X% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting." ... 1.16.1: Armor Penetration

author: Dragunovi
summary: Stated relic design principle: relics should add or change abilities substantially, not be flat power boosts to single abilities as in later expansions.
quote: Our vision on relics is that relics should add new effects or change abilities in a substantial way and not to function as flat power upgrades for specific abilities like later expansions did.

author: Dragunovi
summary: 1.17.0 adds Vampirism (% of damage returned as healing) and Reduced Chance to Get Critically Hit; a doubled casting-speed Haste was reverted at the last moment for overpowered healer synergy; parry stat cost lowered from 15.65 to 13.35.
quote: Vampirism: ... "% of your damage is returned as healing." ... This change had to be reverted last second due to overpowered synergy with healers ... Increased Chance to Parry stat cost has been decreased from 15.65 to 13.35.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Annihilator's proc now uses the Rivenspike/Bashguuder effect and no longer stacks with Faerie Fire, because stacking could drop raid-boss armor to zero and make armor penetration worthless.
quote: The effect allowed users to drop the armor value of raid bosses to 0, making armor penetration items worthless in the raid environment ... the intention is for it to not stack with existing armor reduction effects.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Core rationale for the big item nerfs: on a permanently-1.12 server, items designed to skip progression (Bloodvine set, Lionheart Helm, Naxxramas trash drops) cut out whole parts of the game; the Titanic Leggings nerf was itself softened as too harsh.
quote: we're on a technically forever 1.12.2 server which has dedicated 20 man raids and crafted items designed to skip progression ... Bloodvine Set was so powerful its the best ever armor Booökins were able to get and rivaled Tier 3 ... Naxxramas Trash Drops are one of the biggest culprits, these items were on par and most times even better than actual Naxxramas boss dropped items

author: Dragunovi
summary: PvP gloves that scaled with Judgement of the Crusader began scaling per Crusader Strike stack, yielding 100-165 holy spellpower at five stacks; never intended, so they were retuned.
quote: Crusader Strike allows you to benefit from these effects for every stack, granting a crazy 100 and 165 holy spellpower at 5 stacks. This was never an intended change

author: Dragunovi
summary: Weapons with on-hit procs deliberately do not get feral attack power, because feral druids cannot use the weapon's main stat.
quote: Weapons with on hit procs do not get feral attack power as they can't benefit from the main stat of the weapon.

author: Torta
summary: Onyxia and Ragnaros were dropping T2 helms and leggings twice; removed.
quote: Removed double drop of T2 helms/leggings from Onyxia and Ragnaros.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Diamond Flask's scaling was cut because a level 50 Sunken Temple quest reward should not be a best-in-slot endgame sustain trinket.
quote: Diamond Flask was never designed to be this Best In Slot sustain trinket for warriors ... you don't see other Level 50 Sunken Temple quest rewards at that stage.

author: Jamey
topic_title: NPC Trash Collector Gaston and sold items
summary: Gaston only recovers destroyed items; sold items come back through the vendor buyback tab.
quote: Sold items you can get back through the buyback tab at a vendor. Gaston only collects items that are destroyed.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: Unique items - should be cannot *use* two at once, not cannot *carry* two at once
summary: Unique items cannot be carried in duplicate, not merely equipped; treated as the same thing.
quote: Technically, it's the same thing

author: Dragunovi
summary: Alternative tier sets let specs with poor tier itemization swap Tier 1, 2, 2.5 and 3 pieces (T1/T2 as recolors) for spec-tailored versions with new bonuses; enchants are lost on turn-in and Tier 3.5 cannot be swapped.
quote: These armor sets allow specializations that struggle with itemization to swap their tier pieces to versions that are tailored towards their preferred version, complete with all new set bonuses ... Tier 3.5 won't be available to be swapped using this NPC, pick your set wisely!

author: Akalix
summary: Response to 'copying' accusations: vanilla offers limited design space so overlap with other Vanilla+ projects is inevitable.
quote: there is a limited amount of options for us to change in Vanilla WoW, meaning we will likely have some feature overlap with other versions of Vanilla WoW.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Tier 0.5 / Dungeon Set 2 pieces were all raised to item level 60 epics, lifting their stat budget above the original 65-66 blues and level 55 epic gloves.
quote: All pieces of the set are now item level 60 epics. This affects the item level 65-66 blues and the item level 55 epic gloves for all sets, increasing their stat budget.

author: Dragunovi
summary: AQ20 set weapons lacked the Unique flag they have in retail vanilla, attributed to a VMaNGOS oversight, and were fixed.
quote: Most likely an oversight by VMaNGoS itself as we haven't touched most AQ20 set weapons before this, I'll add the unique flag to them with this patch.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Transmogrified tier pieces still count for set bonuses; any appearance of losing them is a visual bug only.
quote: It's a visual bug. All bonuses continue to work.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Alternative set bonuses were deliberately held until Class Changes 2 shipped so they would not conflict with new abilities.
quote: Set bonuses are very tied to Class Changes 2, if we were to make set bonuses now they might conflict or not include any new abilities that were added with class changes

author: Torta
summary: The lost-item vendor holds a limited rolling list (about 256 items) where new entries displace old ones; it is not storage.
quote: The amount of items displayed in this vendor is very limited, and the newest will replace the oldest, don't use it as an item storage.

author: Dragunovi
topic_title: The suggestion about adjusted Fallen Crusader Legguards in the patch feb 14
summary: The flat bonus damage on Fallen Crusader Legguards was worth about 392 attack power versus undead — roughly 2297% of the item's stat budget — so such effects will not return.
quote: the flat damage component was about equal to 392 Attack Power versus undead which is about 2297%(!) of the item's stat budget ... I wouldn't expect this or a similiar effect to return anytime soon.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Repairable throwing weapons make them viable as itemized drops in future content.
quote: This change does make throwing weapons more sensible as drops when they don't just disappear when they are fully expended so they're much more plausible to add in future content, especially with stats

author: Dragunovi
summary: Meditation was rebudgeted after calculations showed it beats MP5 from near pre-BIS gear upward and scales with the Human spirit racial.
quote: We've done the calculations on this stat and it can surpass MP5 in close to pre-BiS gear and even surpass it with anything higher and even scaling with the Human racial, its been a sleeper stat all this time

author: Akalix
topic_title: Risk Your Item: The Power of Fel Fragments
summary: Random upgrade mechanics on drops are rejected because vanilla's time-gated gearing and fixed BIS lists would make them purely frustrating.
quote: in a game with such heavily time-gated gearing as Vanilla WoW, and such solid ideas of "BIS" -- it'll very likely just lead to frustration as players will find their best items are locked behind RNGing their already RNG drops.

author: Jamey
summary: Rare BoE drop rates in Black Morass, Stormwind Vault and Karazhan Crypt raised from 0.0031%-0.01% to 0.02%.
quote: Increased the drop chances of endgame custom dungeon Bind on Equip rare drops from 0.0031%-0.01% to 0.02%.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Patch 1.17.2 added over 1300 new items, not counting changes, alternative tier sets, Tier 3.5 and Jewelcrafting sets.
quote: amassing over 1300(!) new items for this patch alone, some with completely new effects such as the new relics and quite a few items from Upper Karazhan.

author: Akalix
summary: Enlargement Balsam was removed because oversized characters in capitals put off new players and broke the blizzlike feel; Firewater still enlarges within limits.
quote: It's something which has been continually been off-putting for new players -- walking into Stormwind and seeing a comically large gnome isn't exactly giving a "blizzlike" feeling.

author: Torta
topic_title: Transmogrification: Toggling to Disable or not?
summary: After a community poll, no open-world transmog-off toggle; illusions and Orb of Deception banned outright in BGs and arenas, including class bugs that force them.
quote: we've decided not to add a transmog toggle in the open world. For many, a character's appearance is part of the RPG experience ... Illusions and Orb of Deception will be fully banned in battlegrounds and arenas, including any class-specific bugs that force them on.

author: Torta
summary: Starting-zone rented mounts reworked to 40% speed for 5 minutes at a cost of 1 silver.
quote: Rented mounts in starting zones have been reworked. They now grant 40% movement speed for 5 minutes at the cost of 1 silver.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Sigil of Ancient Accord got a 2-second internal cooldown specifically to stop fast proc-fishing via AoE spells.
quote: It can only trigger once every 2 seconds ... Its primarily meant to curb fishing procs very fast.

author: Torta
summary: The 2025 Alt'lympic mount is deliberately not usable at level one, unlike the previous year's gorilla.
quote: This isn't a bug. This year's Alt'lympic mount isn't intended to be usable at level one. If we want to give level-one players a mount obtainable through gameplay, it will have to be a level-one effort.

author: Dragunovi
summary: 1.18.1 adds Fortune (increases the chance to trigger chance-based item effects, restricted to necklaces, cloaks and trinkets because it compounds) and Avoidance.
quote: Fortune is a new stat ... "Increases your chance to trigger chance based item effects by X%." ... Due to its compounding power with multiple chance based items, the Fortune stat can only be found on Necklaces, Cloaks and Trinkets.

author: Torta
summary: Survival is revived as a secondary skill (max 150) giving Dim Torch (+4 spirit party), Fishing Boat (+50 fishing), Traveler's Tent (rested XP) and Bright Campfire (+8 spirit party).
quote: We're bringing back another discontinued feature of Classic World of Warcraft: the old Secondary Skill: Survival ... How to build a [Traveler's Tent] to have some rest during your journey. The tent lasts 20 minutes and gives you a resting bonus

author: Torta
summary: Fixes to Survival: Bright Campfire grants +1 Survival skill and no longer triggers PvP mode; tent radius raised from 10 to 15 yards.
quote: Bright Campfire now will correctly give you +1 Survival Skill. Bright Campfire won't trigger PvP mode. Traveler's Tens radius will increase from 10 yards to 15 yards.

author: Torta
summary: All current and future epic BoP profession crafts require the crafting skill to equip, so players cannot swap professions to collect the personal reward of every profession.
quote: All current and future Epic Bind on Pickup profession crafts now require the skill that's required to craft the item to equip. This has been done to avoid meta scenarios where the player could make these items which were intended to be the personal bonus for leveling up the profession

author: Pepesmite
summary: Tents differ only cosmetically by faction, are learned through the Survival profession in Stranglethorn and grant no buff beyond rest.
quote: tents are not racial. Yes, they have factional differences in appearance and nothing more. This is the profession you learn in Stranglethorn valley and other than rest points you can't get any buffs.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Belt buckles were never intended to be blacksmith-only; the restriction was a miscommunication.
quote: they were never intended to be Blacksmith only and it was merely a case of miscommunication on our part.

author: Jamey
summary: Small Thorium Veins in Hateforge Quarry given a prohibitively long respawn like other vanilla dungeon nodes.
quote: Nodes will now have a prohibitively high respawn timer, similar to other Vanilla dungeons (Wailing Caverns, Blackrock Depths, etc.).

author: Torta
summary: Plaguebloom added inside Stratholme with non-respawning nodes, as an economy measure.
quote: Plaguebloom is now found growing within Stratholme. However, it's important to note that these herb nodes will not respawn, as is typical for instanced content.

author: Akalix
summary: Rich Thorium Veins share spawn points with regular Thorium Veins outside instances.
quote: Rich Thorium Veins now share spawn locations with regular Thorium Veins. This does not include nodes found in instances.

author: Akalix
summary: Herbalism, mining and high-tier fishing pools moved to a dynamic respawn system to raise supply and lower consumable prices; instance nodes are exempt.
quote: we now have moved our herbalism and mining nodes onto a dynamic respawning system ... Resource nodes found inside instances are exempt from this system.

author: Torta
summary: Black Lotus secondary drop chance from Dreamfoil, Mountain Silversage, Plaguebloom and Icecap raised from 2% to 4% (earlier raised from 0.5% to 1%).
quote: Increased the Black Lotus drop rate from low-level herbs to 4% from 2%.

author: Torta
summary: Clarification that the Black Lotus secondary drop (2% to 4%) comes only from Dreamfoil, Mountain Silversage, Plaguebloom and Icecap, not from low-level herbs.
quote: To clarify: Black Lotus has an additional drop chance, going from 2% to 4%, from the following herbs:

author: Akalix
summary: Enchanting rod behaviour is a vanilla limitation.
quote: We've discussed this internally -- apparently this is a vanilla limitation.

author: Torta
summary: World PvP is opt-in through the .pvp command; final PvP sets available from launch; WSG open from level 1.
quote: You can experience the world in a PvP or PvE setting by using our custom, in game command to turn PvP ON or OFF at any time! .pvp off and you're safe! ... Final versions of PvP sets will be available from the start. No waiting until 1.11!

author: Torta
summary: Battleground queueing from taverns (rather than a command or battlemasters only) was chosen to keep BGs open to casual players instead of dedicated rankers; a .joinbg command was rejected as less lore-friendly.
quote: Here on Turtle WoW we prefer a "chaotic" and random system so everyone has a chance to do BGs. The alternate solution would be a command like ".joinbg" which is less lore friendly in our point of view.

author: Torta
summary: The Bloody Tournament gave doubled honor in the Battle Ring and Bloody Coins for kills, with a no-group rule to stop camping; later the honor rate was returned to blizzlike and the item/XP vendor removed.
quote: To prevent group camping, you won't earn Bloody Coins if you are in a group.

author: Torta
summary: Negative honor rank (Pariah) has no gameplay effect on Turtle; only negative faction reputation makes NPCs refuse trade and attack.
quote: If you lower your honor rank to Pariah, nothing will change, apart if having a long way back if you ever decide to get back to positive ranking. If you lower reputation rank with any faction where it's possible, then yes, nobody will trade you anything ... It's mostly visual

author: Torta
summary: Weekly City Protector titles: the top honorable-kill player of each playable race gets a race-specific title plus a Medallion teleport to their capital with a 60-minute cooldown, lasting one week.
quote: If the PvP stage is active enough each week, 8 players will be granted the title of "City Protector" ... allowing them to teleport to their homeland, with a cooldown of 60 minutes.

author: Torta
summary: Battlegrounds grant XP (5% of a level for a win, 2.5% for a loss), stoppable with the free Turtle Twink's Insignia; BG start thresholds were WSG 2, AB 6, AV 10 during the event.
quote: You will gain experience by doing Battlegrounds. 5% of the level if you win, and 2.5% of the level if you lose (you can always stop your experience gaining getting the Turtle Twink's Insignia for free

author: Torta
summary: November 2019 PvP compromise: temporarily disable open-world honor to push battlegrounds, move some Alliance PvPers to Horde, leave item requirements unchanged, ban win-trading, WSG at 3v3.
quote: For a short time as an experiment we turn off honor gains in the open world to encourage battlegrounds ... No wintrading. WSG is set 3x3.

author: Torta
summary: November 2019 PvP tuning: win-trading forbidden, open-world (and arena) honor cut to 25% temporarily, WSG start threshold lowered to 3 per side, spell cooldowns reset on entering or resurrecting in a BG, Plainsrunning disabled in battlegrounds.
quote: Win-trading is forbidden ... Honor gains in the open world has been decreased to 25%. This change is temporary. Arena is included. Your spell cooldowns now will reset if you join Battleground or resurrect on Battleground. Plainsrunning has been disabled on Battlegrounds.

author: Torta
summary: Bounty Board rules: the enemy player with the most honorable kills last week becomes a weekly non-repeatable bounty; group kills do not count; reward 1 gold and capital reputation.
quote: You must kill the player listed as target to complete the quest. Group kills will not count. An active player with the highest amount of Honorable Kills on the Last Week will become a target of the Bounty Hunt for the opposite faction!

author: Torta
summary: Converting the realm to full world PvP is refused: it was built for PvE players who dislike world PvP, and at that population rewards would be trivially farmed.
quote: We made this server for PvE folks who don't like World PvP. I highly doubt they'd change their mind. Not worth time implementing :) + with our population it'd be like handing rewards for free.

author: Torta
summary: In 2020 cross-faction battleground registration was refused on identity grounds and as beyond the developer's technical reach — a position later reversed when mercenary/cross-faction BGs shipped in 2025.
quote: This suggestions is being brought up here and there since the last month but I'm really against it. It'd destroy what's left of each faction's identities.

author: Torta
summary: 2021 position: only Blood Ring would go cross-faction, other battlegrounds never; rank decay stays because Turtle ranking is already easier than vanilla. Both positions were later reversed.
quote: Blood Ring is going to be cross-faction and have reputation rewards at some point. But turning other battlegrounds cross-faction won't happen ... Ranking on Turtle is much easier comparing to the original Vanilla, removing decay would make it even more easy

author: Torta
topic_title: Add battleground NPCs to the Gurubashi Arena
summary: 1.15.2 was to add a minimap button to queue for battlegrounds anywhere, with PvP tabards again requiring reputation to equip.
quote: With Patch 1.15.2 there's gonna be a button on minimap to queue from any place in the world :) The Tabards will yet again require reputation to be equipped.

author: Torta
summary: Alterac Valley restored to its early-vanilla state in 1.16.4: original terrain and graveyards, original creature spawns, mines, All Seeing Eye and Ryson's Beacon quests, Korrak the Bloodrager objective.
quote: Alterac Valley will be restored to its original state from early Vanilla, with a few custom additions on top ... Restored Master Ryson's quest to find the All Seeing Eye ... The quest that requires you to win Alterac Valley has been replaced with the original quest to kill Korrak

author: Torta
summary: A daily Call to Arms rotation was implemented so all battlegrounds get played.
quote: Implemented daily Call to Arms rotation. Battleground holidays will change every day to promote playing all battlegrounds.

author: Torta
summary: WSG powerup respawn timers set explicitly: Food 20s, Berserk 120s, Speed 150s.
quote: Corrected respawn time of buffs in WSG. Food Buff is 20 seconds, Berserk Buff is 120 seconds, and Speed Buff is 150 seconds.

author: Akalix
summary: Taking War Mode exposes you to attack from unflagged players who flag by attacking you; this is base-game behaviour.
quote: Including those who are not flagged, but opt to flag themselves by attacking you. This is base game behavior, and is no different than world pvp on any typical PvE server.

author: Akalix
summary: No mechanism will be built to let hardcore players take War Mode's 30% XP bonus without its risk.
quote: We do not plan to add more complicated systems to enable HCs to take a 30% exp boost without the added risk.

author: Torta
summary: Korrak's health cut repeatedly (to a quarter of the original) so a solo player can complete the objective without team help.
quote: Korrak's health has been reduced once again, to make it easier for players to kill him when the rest of team doesn't want to help. It's now a quarter of what it was originally.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: In PvP against high-latency players, the client doesn't show the correct position of moving targets
summary: Position desync against high-latency players is inherent to the 2006 client/server model and is not treated as a fixable design issue.
quote: There is actually no design or solutions here. This is how the server and client worked in 2006 and exactly how it works now.

author: Moriena
topic_title: Does enabling War Mode disable Cross-faction raids/dungs
summary: War Mode does not affect cross-faction grouping; it only removes the ability to toggle /pvp. PvP inside cross-faction groups is prohibited, including healing a faction-mate fighting the other side.
quote: Warmode just disables the option to /pvp at will until turned off. It has no affect on guilds/groups/raids. Remember that PvP in Crossfaction Groups is prohibited though.

author: Akalix
topic_title: PvP should only be allowed in Warmode outside BG's
summary: War Mode is framed as a trade, not a free bonus; no partial-flagging or level-range restrictions will be added.
quote: Warmode is not a free 30% experience bonus. If you choose to opt into permanent flagging, do not be surprised when you die. We are not adding "flag for the next day" or "x level range for pvp."

author: Jamey
summary: Assisting a flagged group member inside a dungeon no longer flags you for PvP, so dungeon runners need not flag.
quote: It allows dungeon runners to not have to PvP flag.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: Ganking is utterly pervasive, and harmful to the server. Proposed solutions.
summary: Canonical list of the only ways to be drawn into PvP on the RP-PvE realm: War Mode, attacking the other faction, PvP quests, letting the flag activate, or entering BGs/Blood Ring. Otherwise PvP cannot happen; griefing remains a rule violation.
quote: 1. Do not use the Warmode challenge. 2. Refrain from attacking players from the opposing faction. 3. Avoid quests that are related to PVP and may activate the PVP flag. 4. Ensure that the PVP flag is not activated ... 5. Do not enter battlegrounds or the Bloodring.

author: Torta
topic_title: Steps we take to reduce the queue, and patch 1.17.0 release
summary: Blood Ring PvP realm ruleset: no cross-faction interaction at all, 1.5x honor for city leaders, no War Mode, no Hardcore, lower BG start thresholds (WSG 8, AB 10, AV 30).
quote: There is no crossfaction interaction in any form ... The honor rewards for killing City Leaders have been increased by a rate of 1.5. War Mode is not available on this realm ... Warsong Gulch: 8 players, Arathi Basin: 10 players, Alterac Valley: 30 players.

author: Akalix
summary: Rank decay no longer de-ranks: RP decays but never falls below the minimum for the current rank. Mercenary cross-faction BGs and deeper PvP itemization planned for the 1.17.x cycle.
quote: you can no longer drop PvP ranks by decaying. Decay still happens but your total amount of RP will never drop below the minimum amount of RP required for your current rank.

author: Akalix
summary: Exact RP floors per rank published: R1 15HK, R2 2000, then +5000 per rank up to R14 60000.

author: Torta
summary: No cross-realm battlegrounds between the PvE and PvP EU realms; gear disparity would be unfair to the PvP realm.
quote: No, it's be unfair towards ungeared players from PvP realm.

author: Torta
summary: The War Mode glyph stays on the PvE realm even after the PvP realm opens.
quote: No, we don't plan to remove it.

author: Jamey
summary: There is a weekly restart specifically to flush honor, usually carrying bugfixes with it.
quote: There's a weekly restart for honor flushes. Usually a lot of bugfixes are accompanied by these restarts as well.

author: Torta
summary: Turtle PvP feature set on both PvE and PvP worlds: Blood Ring 3v3 arena with Steamwheedle Blood Ring reputation, new battleground Sunnyglade Valley, and no de-ranking from decay.
quote: Blood Ring. A 3v3 arena where you can earn reputation for the Steamwheedle Blood Ring ... New Battleground: Sunnyglade Valley ... No De-Ranking: Allowing breaks.

author: Akalix
summary: Blood Ring arena rules: pet trinkets disabled, world buffs stripped on entry, unlimited mana in prep phase, soul shards refunded, full health/mana restored after a match; BG queues pause rather than cancel; Dishonorable Kills removed pending rework.
quote: Pet Trinkets are now disabled in the arena; Worldbuffs are now removed upon entering the arena; Mana is now unlimited in the pre-game preparation phase; Soul Shards used in arenas are now refunded after the match ends ... Dishonorable Kills have been removed, pending a larger scale rework.

author: Torta
summary: Dishonorable kills were redefined: they come from killing grey-level players, not from killing civilian NPCs. Items restored by Gaston become soulbound.
quote: Dishonorable kills will now be given for killing players that are grey to you, not for killing civilian NPCs. Rejoice, war criminals!

author: Dragunovi
summary: The arena pet-trinket ban targets pets stacked for spell pushback (yeti, greench, servant bell, timberling), not Timbermaw Ancestor.
quote: It does not include the Timbermaw Ancestor, it should include most things like yeti, greench, servant bell and timberling though, mainly pets that get stacked to hard pushback casters.

author: Akalix
summary: War Mode retuned to 20% bonus honor from all sources and 20% bonus experience.
quote: War Mode has been changed to give 20% bonus honor from all sources, but reduced to 20% bonus experience.

author: Torta
summary: Blessing of Protection and Divine Intervention can no longer be cast on a WSG flag carrier unless the flag is dropped manually first.
quote: Casting Blessing of Protection or Divine Intervention on the flag carrier in WSG is no longer possible unless the flag is dropped manually first.

author: Torta
summary: Flag carriers can remain stealthed but casting stealth drops the flag; Blessing of Protection and Divine Intervention cannot be cast on a flag carrier unless the flag is dropped first.
quote: You can now use stealth while carrying the flag in WSG. However, casting it will cause the flag to drop.

author: Akalix
summary: Consumables deliberately do NOT persist through death in battlegrounds, so consuming does not become a barrier to entry for PvP; jujus not considered problematic.
quote: That is intended. We do not want consuming to become a barrier to entry for doing a battleground. ... We do not view Jujus as problematic currently.

author: Akalix
summary: The server core has no mechanism for cross-realm battlegrounds.
quote: We do not currently have a way in our core to do crossrealm battlegrounds.

author: Akalix
summary: PvP-flagged players in combat cannot enter a battleground, closing the trick of queueing to escape a world fight; The Cleaner teleports Hardcore players away instead of killing them.
quote: You can no longer enter battlegrounds while you are in combat if PvP flagged to prevent abusing battleground queues to escape fights with other players unharmed ... The Cleaner will now teleport Hardcore players away instead of instakilling them.

author: Akalix
summary: Death-penalty designs in battlegrounds produce corner-hiding rather than skilled play, as already observed with hardcore players who queue.
quote: any time the design outcome is a player has to avoid dying in a BG at all costs, it doesn't lead to "playing skilled" -- it leads to people hiding away from combat in corners. This is currently what happens with any Hardcore players who queue for battlegrounds

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: I was banned from the battlefield for 48 hours
summary: Being AFK in battlegrounds is prohibited and results in battleground suspensions after repeated reports and log review.
quote: our server rules strictly prohibit being AFK in battlegrounds

author: Akalix
topic_title: Enforce Rules Against Honor Boosting- Tel'Abim Server
summary: Honor boosting is bannable; 'pool boosting' that only enlarges honor brackets is not punished, but multiboxing to do it remains banned on Tel'Abim.
quote: Honor boosting is bannable and results in punishments whenever discovered. "Pool boosting" -- which simply serves to increase the size of honor brackets ... is not punished. Multiboxing, however, is still not allowed on Tel'Abim

author: Reynolds
summary: There is a hidden 'Contested PvP' flag separate from the visible green PvP flag; it governs neutral-guard hostility and has its own fall-off timer.
quote: The "Contested PvP" flag is different from the green name PvP flag that you know. The Contested PvP flag is a hidden feature from players, and it dictates whether neutral guards attack you like in the goblin towns, and it has its own fall-off timer

author: Akalix
summary: A leaderboard entrant farming honorable kills on an alt account was disqualified; wintrading and PvP multiboxing are both banned.
quote: they've just been using an alt account to farm HKs on themself. We do not allow wintrading or PvP multiboxing, so needless to say they will be "disqualified" from the leaderboard.

author: Torta
summary: Killing players connected from the same IP no longer grants honor, blocking self-honor farming.
quote: Killing players connected from the same IP address as you no longer grants honor.

author: Akalix
summary: Honor is criticised as a time-grind rather than a skill measure; rated PvP requested but population-limited; team reserves the right to make unpopular calls.
quote: the optimal way to rank up is not improving your gameplay, it's increasing how much time you spend grinding honor. The system, especially at the higher levels, requires an unsustainable amount of queue spamming ... we reserve the right to make unpopular decisions if we think they will be beneficial to the overall health of the network.

author: Torta
summary: The War Mode challenge cannot be started on PvP realms.
quote: It won't be possible to start War Mode challenge on PvP realms.

author: Jamey
summary: Global PvP scalars from 1.18.0: -15% player physical damage, -20% player magical damage, -20% incoming player healing and -15% absorbs in PvP combat, -20% mana costs in arenas/BGs; plus new arena map, 2v2, rated teams, WSG flag-carrier stacking debuff and a DoT on rule-defined safespots.
quote: All incoming Physical Damage from other Players is reduced by 15%. All incoming Magical Damage from other Players is reduced by 20%. While in PvP combat (in both Open World and Battlegrounds/Arenas) all incoming Player Healing is reduced by 20% and all incoming Player Absorb Shields are reduced by 15%. While in an Arena or Battleground all Mana Costs are reduced by 20%.

author: Torta
summary: War Mode redesign for 1.18.0: permanent PvP toggled at the Battlemaster, ends at 60, no longer selectable at character creation; not extended past 60 because exclusive honor rewards would unbalance PvP ranking.
quote: War Mode puts your character in permanent PvP. You can toggle it on or off at any time at you Battlemaster. The challenge will still end automatically when you reach level 60 ... we can't give exclusive Honor rewards to War Mode players at level 60, as that would put those without it at a clear disadvantage in the PvP ranking system.

author: Torta
topic_title: Crossfaction Battlegrounds are coming to PvE Realms!
summary: Cross-faction (mercenary) battlegrounds enabled on all PvE realms from the 4 November 2025 maintenance; requires a launcher-only client update.
quote: players, depending on team imbalance in a given Battleground, may end up fighting for the opposite faction for that game to increase fairness and reduce queue times.

author: Jamey
summary: Cross-faction BGs auto-sort players into whichever faction needs them; they do not allow mixed-faction premades.
quote: Crossfaction BGs will auto sort you to any available faction to alleviate queue times and mix-up PvP in BGs. It does NOT allow you to queue a BG as a premade group of both factions in that group.

author: Jamey
summary: The BG queue prioritizes same-faction matching before a cross-faction swap; staff say queue times were unaffected.
quote: Battleground Queue System will now prioritize matching you with your own faction before considering a Cross-Faction swap. This is an internal change more than anything.

author: Torta
summary: Resilience reduces the entire critical damage taken, not just the bonus portion.
quote: Resilience now reduces the entire critical damage taken, not just the bonus critical damage.

author: Torta
summary: Open world PvP will not return in its old form because it was dominated by killing brand-new characters during their intro cinematic; War Mode stays as it is for now.
quote: the biggest part of World PvP for Lunatics was slashing brand-new characters during their intro cinematic, basically killing them before they even finish loading into the game for the first time ... There's no way we'll bring this kind of experience back for players.

author: Torta
summary: Correcting the timeline: challenges have been selectable at character creation since 1.17.2 (1 Nov 2023) while War Mode changed in August 2025; 'cinematic kills' grew into a network-wide problem, and tutorial towns will stay protected in any future War Mode.
quote: Level One Lunatic and the challenges UI on creation were introduced on November 1 2023 in patch 1.17.2 ... while War Mode was changed in August 2025 ... if it is we'll still protect tutorial towns to ensure that the very-very early experience isn't ridiculed in a way that drives newcomers away from the server.

author: Jamey
summary: The flat PvP dampening debuff from 1.18.0 becomes class/spec-specific in 1.18.1.
quote: The PvP Dampening Debuff introduced in 1.18.0 will now have dynamic reductions of Magical and Physical damage based on your class / spec instead of a flat number for all classes.

author: Torta
summary: The honor/PvP reward progression rework was not in the 1.18.1 changelog because it required large itemization changes and the acquisition path was not finished; 1.18.1 still brings Thorn Gorge, new world-PvP events, arena consume restrictions and PvP dampening.
quote: The new PvP reward progression, which was meant to be the highlight for PvP in the Nightmares of Ursol, required significant itemization changes, took far longer than we expected, and we still haven't implemented a way to obtain all of those rewards. It isn't in the changelog because we don't know whether we'll have it ready in time for the release.

author: Torta
summary: Redwall Keep, the low-level world PvP area in Redridge, was not designed for the Level One Lunatic community.
quote: No, it wasn't designed for lunatics.

author: Jamey
summary: 1.18.1 PvP overhaul: the two-tier PvP set rewards are sunset for a three-tier structure (~ilvl 71 rare, ~77 epic, ~92 epic); honor is credited immediately and becomes a currency, ending the weekly-standings competition for rank points.
quote: The old 2-tiered PvP Armor Set Rewards will be sunset and will no longer be obtainable ... Honor gained through these ways will now be credited to the Player immediately. This also implies that you will no longer be "fighting" for your spot to gain Honor/RP based on weekly standings. Honor will now be a currency

author: Bowser
topic_title: About languages and cross-faction chat once more.
summary: A language-learning system was planned from the start, modelled on an unfinished Blizzard alpha feature, to be delivered as a quest chain if technically feasible.
quote: Blizzard had a language skill system in one of the Alpha client versions but it was never finished. We will setup as suggested a quest chain if we manage to find a technical solution.

author: Torta
summary: The player-driven Mirage Raceway was inferred from unused client spells and items (Gnome/Goblin Prize Boxes, Car Keys), not from a Blizzard statement.
quote: I can't recall them saying anything about it, but we've found a number of unused spells related to the raceway in the client files ... Thus, we assumed, it was initially planed as a player controlled raceway.

author: Gheor
summary: No new playable races were planned in 2021 because each needs animation sets and item fitting; Hyjal was named as a future zone.
quote: No plans for new playable races yet, it thanks a long time and we still have to complete goblins, having new sets of animations, making all items fit and a lot of other things are to be considered for playable races.

author: Gheor
summary: Void Elves and Half-Elves rejected as later-expansion inventions with no place on Turtle.
quote: Void Elf is an abomination that future expansion brought so they could add High Elves to Alliance, that's not what we want or need here.

author: Dragunovi
summary: Some locations (Icepoint Rock, a secret sewer entrance to Stormwind Vault) are deliberately undocumented.
quote: Icepoint Rock is a secret location with content that you will have to figure out how to go there yourselves ... It's Mysteries of Azeroth for a reason.

author: Gheor
summary: Night Elf Mages rejected on lore grounds: only the corrupted Shen'drelar Highborne use arcane magic after the Sundering.
quote: The Night Elves would not and will not take magic, especially not after the events of the Sundering, we try to look at it from the lore perspective. Night Elf Mages shouldn't exist.

author: Gheor
summary: Custom quests intentionally withhold exact coordinates; the team argues players are used to Questie/pfQuest rather than vanilla-style directions.
quote: So not delivering all details on a silver platter is anti-intuitive. Since when do quests need to tell you the exact area you need for the objective to be complete? You forget these quests exist in Vanilla too, you're just too used to the Questie or pfQuest.

author: Gheor
summary: Stated lore discipline: not inventing convenient lore justifications on demand.
quote: If we pull up lore out of the magical hat every time it suits us we will only walk in the same wrong direction as others did.

author: Lhian
summary: The Forest Song conflict questlines are mutually exclusive: siding with the druids locks the sentinel quests.
quote: Yes, you can only do one side of the conflict. Once you sided with the druids, sentinel quests are locked to you.

author: Lhian
summary: Hyjal is a zone, not a raid; its currency comes from outdoor activities.
quote: Hyjal is not a raid, it is a zone- you can get the currency needed for this from outdoor activities.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: BUG? the flight path between Mudsprocket and Brackenwall Village
summary: The indirect Mudsprocket-Brackenwall flight route is how flights work, not a bug.
quote: What you describe is not a bug. That's how flights between these locations work.

author: Jamey
summary: Silithus Wind Stone respawns set to Blizzard timers: Lesser 5 minutes, normal 15 minutes, Greater 3 hours.
quote: All Lesser Wind Stones now respawn after 5 minutes, Wind Stones after 15 minutes, and Greater Wind Stones after 3 hours, as per Blizzard respawn timers.

author: Torta
topic_title: Turning in Corrupted Sand In Caverns of Time gave no repuation
summary: Corrupted Sand turn-in reputation rewards work as intended; an outdated client can misrepresent them.
quote: The reputation rewards for those quests are functioning as intended. Please ensure that your client is up to date.

author: Torta
summary: The old Glyph of the Stag quest chain was retired and replaced with a new one in the following patch.
quote: The old version of this quest chain is no longer available. The new quest chain to get the Glyph of the Stag will be available in the next patch.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Only Kolkar Bloodchargers can summon Verog; roughly 10-15 kills near the camp are needed, a detail the original 2004 quest text omits.
quote: Only the Kolkar Bloodcharger can summon Verog. So, you'll need to eliminate around 15 of these centaurs in order for one of them to summon Verog.

author: Jamey
summary: Flight masters grow stronger each time they die and respawn, to discourage camping and farming them.
quote: Flight Masters will now grow stronger each time they die and respawn to discourage extended farming/camping.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: Do rares even spawn on this server?
summary: Rare spawn mechanics: at most two rares per zone at a time chosen from the zone's pool, weighted by zone population, with no fixed respawn timer.
quote: No more than 2 rare mobs are allowed on a location at a time ... This means that the chance of Bjarn appearing is 1/5 ... rare creatures do not have a clear spawn time. It can be really 45 minutes and can be 8 hours.

author: Torta
summary: 1.18.0 adds three zones (Grim Reaches, Northwind, Balor), two dungeons (Stormwrought Ruins, Dragonmaw Retreat) and a Molten Core update.
quote: We've got three brand-new zones to explore — Grim Reaches, Northwind, and the haunted island of Balor. Two fresh dungeons are coming, Stormwrought Ruins and Dragonmaw Retreat, plus some big updates to old favorites like Molten Core.

author: Torta
topic_title: On Behalf of the Blue Flight, to TWoW Devs
summary: The blue dragons in Nightmares of Ursol are villains but do not define the flight; their story continues in the following patch, Vision of Mazhtoril.
quote: The group of blue dragons you encounter in Nightmares of Ursol are villains. However, the Blue Dragonflight story in Mysteries of Azeroth is just beginning ... more about them will follow in the next patch, Vision of Mazhtoril.

author: Torta
summary: Founding announcement: PvE/RP focus, reduced kill XP, staggered raid release, cosmetic-only shop, opt-in world PvP via .pvp command.
quote: The main thing in our project will be PvE, role play and communication. We are considering reducing the experience rates for killing mobs (x0.8) ... A shop will be available for cosmetic items ... Nothing will be pay to win or give advantages to a player!

author: Torta
summary: A weekly level cap was considered and rejected: it would force people onto a schedule and overcrowd starting zones, contrary to a project built for unhurried play.
quote: this feature would actually force people to play in a timeframe, without taking their time ... Another reason is overpopulation of start areas, which could cause problems for leveling in general -- the game wasn't designed this way

author: Torta
summary: Launch rates set from beta: quests x1, creature kills x0.5, rested XP bonus x0.5, with WSG open from the 1-9 bracket.
quote: The final rates will be the following: Quest rates: x1, Creature kill rates: x0.5, Rested XP bonus: x0.5

author: Bowser
summary: Early framing of the project's limits: convenience features risk drifting from blizzlike, cross-faction functions should be made lore-friendly (e.g. learning the other faction's language), and WotLK-era features are off the table.
quote: the problem is that it will draw us further away from "Blizzlike" gameplay mechanics ... This is in my point of view no option for Turtle WoW because we would start to introduce major Wotlk+ features on a Vanilla server.

author: Torta
summary: Early retention data drove the rate rethink: about 8,000 characters created but fewer than 500 past level 20, with low rates and lack of cross-faction interaction cited by leavers.
quote: Almost 8000 characters have been created, yet fewer than 500 have reached level 20. We must ask — have we made things too slow?

author: Torta
summary: Progressive kill-XP brackets (0.7-0.9 by level range) were introduced so quests would carry levelling; grey and green quests keep full XP up to 25 levels of difference. Superseded in March 2020 when default rates went to x1 and the brackets were dropped.
quote: Experience rates for killing mobs are generally reduced to x0.8 ... Having "grey" quests that give no experience won't be a reason to leave the zone ... they will still give the full experience up to 25 levels of difference.

author: Torta
summary: In 2019 the team stated Turtle never planned to shut down when Classic released.
quote: Turtle WoW never had plans to shutdown with Classic release, don't worry.

author: Torta
summary: Housing, if built, would be placed in the open world near starting hubs rather than phased or instanced; the team's objection was purpose, not feasibility.
quote: If we ever make player houses, we build them into open world, next to the crowded places such as Goldshire, Razor Hill etc ... So the question is not "How" the question is "Why".

author: Torta
summary: After a poll, default rates went to x1 and progressive brackets were retired; Hardcore stayed optional; grey/green quests keep full XP up to 25 levels' difference.
quote: Default server rates have been set to x1, progressive rate brackets are no longer in use. Hardcore Mode remains optional ... Gray & Green quest still give the full experience up to 25 levels of difference.

author: Torta
topic_title: Make Sunken Temple Class Quests Repeatable!
summary: Statement of philosophy against fun-server design.
quote: The items are pretty good. It's not our intention to turn TW into fun-server that is handing items for no effort.

author: Torta
summary: Rather than easing existing content, the team commits to adding new PvE content; permanent XP boosts rejected, occasional events left open.
quote: We'll be adding new PvE content in the near future, instead of making the existing one easier.

author: Torta
topic_title: mercenary AI player BOT (like escort NPC)
summary: Core project vision: extend Vanilla rather than move to the next expansion, which would make old content useless; content is built manually, not lifted from later expansions' databases.
quote: extending Vanilla instead of moving to the next expansion which would make old content useless ... We are not taking DB from different expansion, we're doing our job properly and manually.

author: Gheor
summary: Dual spec, extra summons and a random dungeon finder are rejected as breaking the vanilla experience; a group finder is argued not to fix tank/healer scarcity, which is a community problem.
quote: You wanna summon party members? Have a warlock around or be a warlock, the game is vast and must be explored, it has to feel like a world, not just teleporting around, it is in essence what destroyed the game in future expansions ... RDF won't change the number of tanks and healers, the community does

author: Torta
summary: Mysteries of Azeroth was planned as a three-part story release because the team was too small to build everything at once; Episode 1 listed Goblins and High Elves, Amani'Alor and Alah'Thalas, 1v1 arena, gambling, Stormwind Vault, 400+ items, Gnome Hunters and Orc Mages.
quote: We will release story in 3 parts. We don't have a team big enough to work on everything at the same time.

author: Gheor
summary: Turtle already has faster travel than typical vanilla servers; more summoning items are opposed because warlocks fill that role.
quote: Travel is already significantly faster on Turtle WoW than it'd be on any other Vanilla Server, I personally disagree with offering more way of summonings, warlocks already fulfill that purpose.

author: Gheor
summary: Standing design position to minimise teleports and portals.
quote: we are trying to cut teleportations and portals as much as possible.

author: Torta
topic_title: Remove Turtle Mounts, Azure Drakes and Cloud Pets
summary: Content is explicitly not final: early non-lore-friendly experiments were replaced as the team grew, and the many non-immersive teleports are slated for eventual removal, constrained by not taking things away from an established community.
quote: Nothing what's being implemented here is final / eternal. Server changes over time are natural and healthy ... we added a lot of non-immersive teleports which we plan to remove in the future.

author: Jamey
summary: 1.15.2 renamed to 1.16.0 'Mysteries of Azeroth' because the scope grew past a content patch; schedule unchanged.
quote: we have decided that the next release will officially be an expansion instead of a patch release and we have moved from labeling it 1.15.2 to 1.16.0 ... Our time schedule has not changed, this is only a version update.

author: Gheor
summary: Statement on how decisions are made: a staff member's personal opinion does not decide anything; the team decides collectively.
quote: These decisions are taken by a team and not an individual, personal opinion doesn't dictate what will or will not happen ... until the team decides is a Do it's a Don't.

author: Akalix
summary: No level 60 boost and no further XP-raising features; elite quests and dungeons already give more XP.
quote: the philosophy behind Turtle WoW is going slow and enjoying the journey, so we won't be adding a boost, and don't plan on implementing any other XP gain raising features.

author: Torta
summary: YouTube channel deleted after copyright strikes; team positions itself as a modding team, not a 'free-wow'.
quote: our channel wasn't monetized, it's been deleted after receiving several copyright strikes ... We always treated the creators respectfully and advertised ourselves as a modding team, not a "free-wow".

author: Gheor
summary: Absolute statement that a level 60 boost will never be added.
quote: We will never add a level 60 boost. It is our goal to develop on all the aspects of the game and we surely won't offer a skip.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Convert xp to money while xp gain is off
summary: Level-locking is not something the team wants to encourage.
quote: we do not necessarily want to encourage people to level lock themselves. What benefit to the server's overall ecosystem does that provide?

author: Torta
summary: Outland remains a possible future direction.
quote: Outland is still on the table :)

author: Akalix
summary: Standing release policy: no dates until near completion.
quote: The only ETA we are currently offering is "When it's ready" ... "A delayed game is eventually good, but a rushed game is forever bad."

author: Akalix
summary: Consolidated standing answers: cross-realm PvP blocked by technical limits, no Turtle: The Burning Crusade ever, classes stay in constant iteration and 'revert CC2' threads are locked, new races/classes unlikely, summoning stones refused.
quote: We do not plan to ever launch a "Turtle: The Burning Crusade" ... threads saying "just revert cc2" will be locked, as we do not plan to "revert" our continued development ... As we do not endorse trapping Warlock players in large rocks, the team doesn't plan to add Summoning Stones.

author: Torta
topic_title: Can the client increase the Chinese?
summary: May 2023 position: English is the only supported language because quality control across languages would delay development by years. Reversed later by the CN realm and Spanish/Portuguese/German/Russian localization.
quote: The only supported language on Turtle WoW is English. We made this decision because we cannot maintain the quality control of our newly written content in several languages. Doing so would slow down the development process by years.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Game Design Podcast with Dave and Dave
summary: Design philosophy: do not design around players skipping story text.
quote: Designing around "people won't read" will result in a server feeling soulless and hollow.

author: Akalix
summary: Team is over 100 people with separate skill silos, so events or soundtracks progressing does not mean dungeon or item work stalled.
quote: The people designing modes, producing soundtracks, creating events, etc... none of them are the same as the people who design dungeons, or items, etc. Completely different skillsets within our team of over 100 people.

author: Torta
summary: New GM-built guild houses discontinued: staff workload, world overcrowding, and unfair gameplay advantages from house teleports/NPCs.
quote: it is no longer possible to construct new guild houses while the system still relies on RP Gamemasters building them in the game world. Another issue with guild houses is that certain teleport locations and NPCs provide gameplay advantages, while others do not. It is unfair that certain guilds and their members enjoy privileges that others cannot have.

author: Torta
summary: Legacy guild houses will not be removed from the open world; phasing them into Caverns of Time was discussed but dropped.
quote: We never considered their complete removal ... We had discussed this possibility to phase them out and make them part of the Caverns of Time experience, but it's likely won't happen, as they're part of the community history and frankly, it's not worth the technical effort

author: Akalix
summary: Final guild-housing position: legacy bases stay, tabards keep working until Guild Bases v2, nothing before late 2024 and not in 1.17.
quote: We will be leaving legacy bases in the open world. Tabards will keep their current function until GBv2 release, when they will be repurposed for the new system ... None of these changes will be happening until late 2024 at the earliest. It is not 1.17 content.

author: Akalix
summary: On major patch day the online DB is locked and the server withholds item data until a player has acquired the item, to protect discovery.
quote: we are excited to embrace the spirit of discovery and adventure by temporarily locking down our online DB website ... we will have an additional server configuration in place to prevent datamining of items until they have been acquired by a player. Once acquired, everyone will be able to query and view that item.

author: Torta
topic_title: What's the point of changelog if you omit changes?
summary: Weekly changelogs accompany maintenance; mid-week hotfix restarts may carry unlisted branch changes that appear in the next weekly changelog.
quote: During these short restarts, not only hotfixes are applied, but also a few changes made in the same development branch. These changes are usually listed in the weekly changelog during the main maintenance.

author: Akalix
summary: Self-description of the project's positioning.
quote: We are a Vanilla+ project. What are we doing to attract new players? Vanilla+.

author: Torta
summary: Roadmap notes Karazhan 40, class reworks, Jewelcrafting, expanded classic dungeons, Level One Lunatic challenge, the South Seas PvE realm with Spanish/Portuguese (and planned German/Russian) localization, and no further European realms planned at that time.
quote: We've opened our South American realm South Seas PvE, and in our quest to bring the game to all, we've translated it into both Spanish and Portuguese, and we're working on getting German and Russian localizations ready too — while we're not planning any new European realms

author: Torta
summary: The level cap stays at 60.
quote: The cap remains 60.

author: Torta
topic_title: This forum is pointless for the Team?
summary: Bug reports belong on the GitHub tracker, not the forum or Discord; suggestions are read but implementation may take a year; a self-hosted tracker was planned.
quote: We're more focused on bug tracker reports because we've got a lot of stuff going on behind the scenes, and adding Forum or Discord reports to our QA/Development routine would overall slow things down.

author: Torta
summary: The bug tracker moved off a personal GitHub account to a self-hosted system; issues were exported and the old tracker made inaccessible.
quote: The issues were fully exported and self-hosted - neither the old tracker nor its account is accessible any longer. Since it was my personal GitHub account, not one belonging to the organization

author: Torta
summary: Large infrequent patches are deliberate: with seven-plus realms, auto-patching creates heavy support load, especially for Linux and Mac users.
quote: auto-patching often causes significant issues on the user side, creating an immense load on our support team ... I'd rather endure one day of a long global release every six months than deal with distributing small patches, because overall, it amounts to the same number of problems.

author: Torta
summary: Suggestions are discussed internally without public replies and can surface a year later; suggestions should not be filed as bug reports.
quote: Suggestions are mostly discussed internally without responses in the thread. Development takes time, and it's common for suggestions made months ago to be implemented in the game the following year or so

author: Torta
topic_title: Tel'Abim should offer boosts to level 50
summary: No levelling boosts on any realm.
quote: We will not offer leveling boosts on any realm.

author: Torta
topic_title: Turtle WoW 2.0 — Powered by Unreal Engine 5
summary: The Turtle WoW 2.0 trailer was taken down after rapid growth; the team argued the content is transformative and moved it to their own site.
quote: our new trailer was given a takedown. While we'll be appealing this decision as our content is highly transformative, we have uploaded it to our website

author: Akalix
summary: Defence of the project's direction: progression beyond vanilla's original end while staying in the familiar world rather than adding new planets or continents that would split the playerbase.
quote: We are releasing content furthering progression beyond the original "end" of the game while sticking to the familiar world rather than adventuring to new planets and continents to split the playerbase.

author: Torta
summary: Legacy guild bases require no renewal action, but a base that blocks future content development must relocate to an existing tavern.
quote: Legacy guild bases will remain without any action required from guilds to renew, regardless of whether an Innkeeper is present. However ... if a guild base interferes with future content development, you will be asked to relocate to an existing tavern.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Turtle Team urgently needs to rethink the entire idea of ​​class change
summary: The team describes the Vanilla+ position as a balancing act criticised from both directions — 'too much +' versus demands like Alliance shamans and Horde paladins.
quote: Some people think we do "too much +", while some others believe we don't do enough (alliance shamans and horde paladins, for example). It's a balancing act we attempt to the best of our abilities

author: Akalix
summary: Characters will always start at level 1.
quote: We do not plan to allow players to start from any level but 1.

author: Adhavar
summary: Patch 1.18.0 launched Mysteries of Azeroth with a German translation: all vanilla content localized, plus much of the UI, locations, spells and creatures, with weekly translation updates and a planned reporting channel.
quote: Mit Patch 1.18 startet Mysteries of Azeroth erstmals mit einer eigenen deutschen Übersetzung! Alle Inhalte aus Vanilla sind bereits vollständig lokalisiert ... Weitere Übersetzungen folgen wöchentlich in regelmäßigen Updates

author: Adhavar
summary: The German translation was redone because vanilla 1.12.1's own German localization was unfinished and inconsistent (e.g. 'Stormwind' alongside 'Wache von Sturmwind').
quote: Patch 1.12.1, auf dem die meisten Privatserver basieren, enthält eine unfertige Lokalisierung ... Das liegt daran, dass 1.12.1 ein Zwischenstand war. Die Übersetzung war einfach noch nicht fertig.

author: Torta
summary: 1.18.1 preliminary notes: Moonwhisper Coast (50-56), Windhorn Canyon dungeon, Timbermaw Hold as a 20-man raid harder than existing 20-mans, refreshed Onyxia's Lair and Blackwing Lair, new PvP events and a Survival profession rework.
quote: Moonwhisper Coast, a brand-new late leveling zone, Windhorn Canyon, one challenging dungeon, Timbermaw Hold, an all-new 20 man raid designed to be harder than the existing 20 man raids ... Onyxia Lair and Blackwing Lair will receive some fresh touches

author: Torta
summary: Open letter positioning Mysteries of Azeroth as a fan modding effort and asking Blizzard for cooperation.
quote: We're Turtle WoW, a group of fans who love World of Warcraft and share a lifelong dream of contributing to its development. Mysteries of Azeroth, our content expansion, is a collective effort of our community members

author: Torta
summary: PvP plans withheld until finalized, to avoid publishing unfinished information.
quote: we'll share them only once everything's finalized so we don't present unfinished information and fuel unnecessary speculations.

author: Torta
summary: Patch 1.18.1 'Nightmares of Ursol' goes live 20 March 2026; the Timbermaw Hold raid opens a week later on 27 March.
quote: our new Patch 1.18.1 — Nightmares of Ursol is going live on March 20 ... the Timbermaw Hold raid will open its doors on March 27, 7PM server time, a week after the release, to ensure that realms are stable and all critical hotfixes are applied.

author: Torta
summary: Shutdown announcement: final day of operation 14 May 2026, servers offline 12:00 AM 15 May; support kept running until the end, donations turned off, all realm timelines immediately shifted to the final progression patch.
quote: After almost 8 years online, Turtle WoW is heading towards shutdown. The final day of operation will be May 14, 2026, and the servers will go offline at 12:00 AM on May 15th ... All realm timelines will be immediately shifted to the final progression patch for those who want to see the new raids before the project's sunset. We've turned off all donations until the end of the project

author: Sleeptime
summary: The SEA realms shut down at the same moment as the rest of the network, 12:00 AM on 15 May 2026.
quote: SEA servers will also go offline at 12:00 AM on May 15th 2026.

author: Torta
summary: The Diplomat questline unlocks cross-faction grouping, chat and trade plus a /diplomacy channel, but not cross-faction guilds at that time.
quote: Diplomacy channel: If you are a diplomat, you can join a cross faction channel by doing /join Diplomacy.

author: Torta
summary: The cross-faction united /world channel was kept after the anniversary because one active chat beats two dead ones; faction-only /alliance and /horde channels were promised with join restrictions.
quote: This setting will remain this way until it's proven to cause harm to the game experience on Turtle WoW. It's better to have one chat full of conversations than two inactive ones.

author: Torta
topic_title: mercenary AI player BOT (like escort NPC)
summary: AI companion bots refused: Turtle had one full-time developer at the time and the team insists an MMO means playing with other players.
quote: MMO means you have to play with other players, even if there are less than 500 players it's still possible to find a friend or ask someone to help you out.

author: Torta
summary: Bot bans require a GM to catch the bot online after a ticket, which is why reports take a day or two.
quote: The only way to get bot banned is to report it to GMs via ticket system. It takes a day or two for us to actually catch him online to verify fact of botting

author: Torta
summary: An item was renamed purely to reduce world-chat trolling and GM moderation load, a decision the admin calls ridiculous but pragmatic.
quote: The item has been renamed in an effort to lessen the stress on our very-very small GM team which grew tired of moderating clowns in a world chat.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Hold a vote on HC graves
summary: Players who used hardcore grave text for slurs were punished.
quote: The player(s) abusing graves for crude messages have been punished :)

author: Torta
summary: Inactive low-level character names are freed on a schedule; characters are not deleted, banned-account names are blacklisted.
quote: Below level 10 and haven't logged in for 6 months. Below level 20 and haven't logged in for 12 months. Below level 40 and haven't logged in for 24 months. The characters will not be deleted, and will receive their ID number instead of the name.

author: Torta
summary: GMs stop transferring misassigned 5-man loot; raids get a 10-minute post-kill trade window instead; lost items recoverable from Trash Collector Gaston at full vendor price.
quote: we will no longer assist with tickets requesting the transfer of an item from one party member to another in any 5-man dungeon ... for a short period of 10 minutes after the boss has been defeated, all raid members will have a claim on the item and can receive it via trade, provided they were present during the boss kill, have not left the raid map, and share the same raid ID ... Each item can only be traded once.

author: Torta
summary: Ban appeals are handled only through the website user panel, never on the forum or Discord, and may take a week.
quote: We do not review ban appeals via forums. Ban appeals are reviewed privately via website user panel, and it may take up to one week to receive a response

author: Torta
topic_title: Faulty Automatic Bans Have Been Revoked
summary: A wave of automatic bans was faulty and was revoked.
quote: Please be assured that your accounts are safe and most likely unbanned by now.

author: Akalix
topic_title: [WARNING]Banning characters below level 20 from speaking in the world and trade channels
summary: A minimum level to use world/trade channels was set at 10 (applied with flexibility) as an anti-RMT measure.
quote: We are handling the level requirement with some flexibility, however we pushed it to 10 earlier. We are very aware of the impact RMT can have on a server

author: Torta
topic_title: Explicitly ban erp in public channels like /s and /me
summary: Vulgar language in public channels is covered by the rules regardless of roleplay framing.
