quote: It is already covered by our rules, regardless of whether vulgar language is used in a roleplay context or not

author: Torta
topic_title: Can we please just ban Chinese IP's?
summary: Racism and nationalism are forbidden; threads humiliating groups lead to account suspension.
quote: We strictly forbid racism and nationalism on our platform. Any further discussions that humiliate specific groups of people will result in the suspension of your accounts.

author: Akalix
summary: NSFW discussion is not permitted network-wide because minors play there; political discussion is likewise barred from public channels.
quote: Discussion of NSFW content is not permitted on our network. Please, remember that there may be minors who play here.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Account sharing is allowed unless used to scam or deceive; the owner is responsible for violations and no character changes made by others are reversed.
quote: Sharing access to your account with others is allowed, as long as it is not used to scam or deceive other members of the community. However, you are responsible for any rule violations that occur while others are using your account.

author: Akalix
summary: RMT punishment: two-week ban, removal of all gold including legitimately earned, and a permanent flag with close monitoring.
quote: When a player is caught participating in RMT, they are banned for two weeks, their gold is all removed (including what they had earned legitimately), and they are flagged.

author: Torta
summary: English enforced technically in General, Trade, World and /yell to reduce GM workload; the Hanzi filter was later extended to /say.
quote: we have enforced English as the mandatory language for communication in the General, Trade, World, and /yell channels. This measure aims to minimize the need for GM intervention.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: Hello GM，EU realm allow Mage Aoe farm work？
summary: Mage AoE grinding (e.g. Blizzard farming in Swamp of Sorrows) is allowed.
quote: Yes this is not restricted.

author: Akalix
topic_title: New queue prioritization system is in place!
summary: English-only rule in public channels predates the queue change; anti-RMT enforcement applies to all realms.
quote: We have continued to monitor and punish RMT. We will continue to enforce our strict anti-RMT policies across all our realms, regardless of region ... we have, and have had for multiple years, a rule requiring English in all public channels.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: Nerfing ZG croc farm is a horrible decision
summary: Position on farming: open-world or dungeon farming without safespots is fine; farming from safespots is blocked and will keep being blocked.
quote: Farming in the open world / dungeon without safespots is good. Second. Farming on safespots in dungeons / open world is not not good. We have blocked and will continue to block this on our server.

author: Akalix
summary: Guild-name moderation is judged on behaviour and branding, not name alone; a blatant name would be renamed, an ambiguous one is not.
quote: If the name was blatant, such as "Hitler Homies" — it would be renamed. However, it's in a dubious area where it requires further information to be related to Nazism.

author: Jamey
summary: Loot obtained by exploiting a repeatable-respawn bug on Lord Blackwald II was confiscated.
quote: Added safeguards to prevent Lord Blackwald II from respawning. Players who have previously exploited this bug will have the loot from exploited kills taken from them.

author: Akalix
summary: Multiboxing fully banned on Tel'Abim except for summoning alts; main realm renamed Nordanaar RPPvE.
quote: The largest of which will be the complete banning of multiboxing on our new realm. The only situation in which people may multibox on Tel'Abim will be for summoning alts.

author: Jamey
summary: Multiboxing is defined as controlling multiple clients simultaneously for combat or movement; bank alts are not multiboxing.
quote: Multiboxing is the act of controlling multiple WoW clients simultaneously. This can entail having multiple clients open on a single machine or utilizing multiple machines to control the actions of both accounts at the same time for combat or moving.

author: Akalix
summary: Alt-tabbing between two clients with one on /follow still counts as banned multiboxing on Tel'Abim.
quote: This is not allowed.

author: Torta
summary: The BWL lockdown was aimed at a known cheat tool that let raids skip the first boss or drag raid bosses into the entry room.
quote: This change has been implemented to combat the behavior of a known cheating software that allowed players to skip the first boss or pull raid bosses into the first boss room without going through the dungeon.

author: Sleeptime
topic_title: A permanent ban for powerleveling with Warmode is excessive.
summary: Multiboxing with PvP/War Mode enabled or in the hardcore challenge is warned first; ignoring warnings brings a permanent ban. Warnings last 7 days and display on login.
quote: GMs still give warnings for multiboxing while having PvP/Warmode enabled or while participating in the hardcore challenge. A permanent ban will be given if warnings are ignored.

author: Torta
topic_title: Turtle WoW ban me for stating that Russia is a terrorist state
summary: Political discussion is banned outright because the project is positioned as an escape from real-world conflict and no 'civilized political discussion' is believed possible in public chat.
quote: There's no such thing as a "civilized political discussion", every mention of those disasters will be followed by insults, mutual humiliation, discrimination ... One of our project's values is it being a safe haven

author: Sleeptime
summary: Wall climbing is allowed in the open world but banned in battlegrounds.
quote: We here at Turtle WoW collectively consider wall climbing as the act of climbing a wall. We allow it in the open-world but not in battlegrounds.

author: Akalix
summary: The long-standing rule against dropping Infernals/Doomguards in crowded areas exists because of Hardcore: those pets can kill without a PvP flag.
quote: This has been in the rules for years. This is due to the Hardcore gamemode. Doomguards and Infernals would not require a PvP flag to kill you when they can become hostile.

author: Akalix
summary: Suspensions were lifted where the detection system may have erred, on the stated principle of preferring to unban a guilty party over leaving an innocent one banned; multiboxing is capped at two clients and never with PvP flags.
quote: I would rather risk unbanning a guilty party than leave an innocent player banned ... Please be cautious when multiboxing to ensure only two clients are involved, and none are flagged for PvP.

author: Vanth
topic_title: Alicemoony botting in WSG with video evidence
summary: Bot accusations are investigated but disciplinary outcomes are never disclosed to other players.
quote: we do not discuss disciplinary actions taken against players with other players at all, therefor any action taken will not be made public.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: Got a notice from gm after being falsely accused.
summary: Deliberately manipulating opposite-faction players into PvP is treated as griefing and warned.
quote: You have received a warning for intentionally using certain methods to bring characters from the opposite faction into PvP. This behavior is considered griefing

author: Akalix
topic_title: Is it allowed to kill Hardcore players with Warmode nowadays?
summary: Killing a hardcore player who flagged willingly (e.g. War Mode) is allowed; tricking or exploiting someone into flagging is punished.
quote: If they have flagged themselves willingly, such as by taking warmode, it is fine. If you trick them into flagging unwillingly or use an exploit to flag them, it is punished.

author: Akalix
summary: Speedrunning is permitted within the terms of service, but overtly broken or exploitative mechanics used in runs get patched out.
quote: People are welcome to play the game in whatever way brings them joy, assuming it's within the terms of service. If there are overtly broken or exploitative mechanics used in speedruns, they will be patched out.

author: Akalix
summary: No jail or special content for banned accounts.
quote: We will not be adding a feature for banned players. They are banned for a reason--we will not give exclusive content to those who have neglected our terms of service.

author: Sleeptime
summary: Spawn camping and corpse camping are explicitly allowed, because PvP is opt-in.
quote: Spawn camping and corpse camping are allowed, as PvP is optional and players can choose to opt out. This isn't considered griefing or anything like that.

author: Akalix
summary: Discord phone verification stays because of rampant scam-link phishing; it is Discord's own verification, not Turtle's.
quote: Discord currently has rampant issues with scammers posting links such as "free steam giftcards" ... this is not verifying your SMS with Turtle WoW -- this is a built in verification with Discord.

author: Akalix
summary: Terrain-altering client mods trip the anticheat as out-of-bounds and get read as wall or teleport hacking; players are told to use a local vmangos instance instead.
quote: You will repeatedly flag our anticheat and our staff will assume you are wall/teleport hacking as you will be flagging as out of bounds.

author: Sleeptime
summary: Deleted characters are not restored, even on ticket.
quote: Unfortunately, we don't restore deleted characters, even if you open a ticket and ask nicely.

author: Pepesmite
summary: GMs do not add mechanics or fix bugs; they process tickets and in-game issues, which is the developers' domain.
quote: GMs don't handle stuff like that—they don't add mechanics or fix bugs. That's the server devs' job. GMs process player tickets and help with in-game issues.

author: Sleeptime
summary: Naming suspensions come only after three chances to pick an acceptable name.
quote: Naming suspensions are issued after three chances to rename your character to something more appropriate.

author: Torta
summary: Ambershire name cleanup: names reserved pre-launch but never taken past level 2 and unused since 1 September are released; ~100k names expected.
quote: Any character that hasn't reached Level 2 and hasn't logged in since September 1 (two weeks after launch) will have its name released.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Deleted characters and accounts are erased outright to save server resources and cannot be restored.
quote: Once you delete an account or character, the information about it is erased. This is done to save server resources.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Names are released only by the automatic inactivity system; staff will not free or reserve a specific name.
quote: Our server has an automatic system for releasing the names of inactive characters, but you cannot guess or find out which name will be released.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Any application or method that synchronises the actions of two accounts is prohibited.
quote: Our server rules prohibit any applications or other methods of synchronising the actions of two accounts when using a multibox.

author: Sleeptime
topic_title: Items lost and GM won't restore?
summary: GMs restore only sold or deleted quest rewards; drops, crafted items and disenchanted items are never restored.
quote: GMs can only restore quest rewards that were sold or deleted. If your item was a drop from a boss, a mob, or crafted by another player, we will not be able to restore it. We cannot restore disenchanted items either.

author: Torta
summary: Character transfers from other private servers are refused as damaging to Turtle's community, balance and progression.
quote: No. Transfers from other servers would ruin Turtle's unique community, balance and progress.

author: Torta
topic_title: Is Gurubashi WoW part of Turtle WoW?
summary: Gurubashi WoW is a separate PvP-focused project supported by Turtle with experience and development, not part of Turtle itself.
quote: It's not a part of Turtle WoW, but we're supporting it with experience and development.

author: Gheor
summary: No transfers from Blizzard Classic Era because of the patch difference and the extent of Turtle's changes.
quote: We do not transfer characters sadly, because of the patch difference and the overall fact we've changed a lot.

author: Torta
topic_title: The website's population graph has broken? (Horde & Alliance swapped places?)
summary: The population graph mis-reported faction balance after 1.16 because of Turtle's custom race IDs; the Alliance is the larger faction.
quote: the faction balance was not shown correctly after patch 1.16. It turned out that the calculation problem was caused by our custom race IDs ... TL;DR: The majority is playing Alliance.

author: Torta
topic_title: I wish the old turtle community could get its own proper RP-server
summary: A dedicated RP realm is rejected because RP spreads by accidental exposure on a mixed realm; an RP-only realm would only attract veterans and wall off newcomers.
quote: This wouldn't be possible on an RP-only server, since it'd only attract experienced roleplayers and instate an entry wall for those who have the potential to become part of the RP community!

author: Torta
topic_title: I wish the old turtle community could get its own proper RP-server
summary: A second (RP) realm was ruled out in 2022 on team-capacity grounds; a dedicated RP realm was also argued to wall off newcomers who discover RP by accident.
quote: We are absolutely not ready to maintain two realms at once with the quality of support and development we expect ourselves to perform, I'm sorry. Our team size isn't comparable to Activision's :)

author: Torta
summary: Kalimdor and Eastern Kingdoms run on different time zones eight hours apart for immersion.
quote: Azeroth is round! Kalimdor and Eastern Kingdoms are now in different time zones with an eight hour difference for increased immersion.

author: Akalix
topic_title: If Fresh server is coming, PLEASE make it PVP server.
summary: Fresh realms are rejected on principle: Turtle's philosophy is longevity and the fresh cycle fractures communities and drives burnout.
quote: Turtle's entire philosophy is being long-lasting and providing a place for people to call home for years to come. The "fresh" mindset leads to fractured communities and increased burnout.

author: Akalix
summary: The main realms are hosted in Europe, so non-European players should expect higher ping.
quote: our servers are located in Europe. This means you will likely be stuck with higher ping than you are accustomed to playing on US servers

author: Akalix
summary: April 2023: no new realms planned and the RPPvE identity will not change — reversed six months later with Tel'Abim PvP.
quote: We are an RPPvE server. We will not change our core identity. If you're looking for a full PvP server, this won't be the place to find it unfortunately.

author: Akalix
summary: No separate Hardcore realm; single-realm philosophy.
quote: we are not planning to open another realm currently, as our philosophy is being a warm, welcoming home for people to play at their own pace, and to come back to later if you opt to take a break.

author: Torta
summary: Credential-stuffing attacks on the auth server attributed to gold sellers; players urged to change reused passwords.
quote: The attackers use leaked data from all over the internet in attempts to guess your logins, supported by botnets that use unique IP addresses for every login attempt. Keep in mind that 90% of those attacks are executed by the gold-sellers.

author: Torta
topic_title: Turtle WoW is expanding to the East!
summary: Separate Asia-hosted Chinese realm at cn.turtlecraft.gg with its own team, mirrored update schedule and gradual free EU->CN transfers.
quote: we have chosen to launch a new realm hosted in Asia! We have selected a Chinese-speaking team to represent, translate, and manage a server in China ... Mirrored update release schedule (with slight delays for translation)

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: On the issue of unchanged queue positions
summary: August 2023 statement that there were no queue-position restrictions and everyone was treated equally — before the veteran/English prioritization introduced in September 2023.
quote: We do not have any restrictions on queue positions. Everyone is in the same conditions.

author: Torta
summary: Queue system modified to prioritize veteran players (work in progress); battleground spirit healers no longer resurrect the opposite faction.
quote: We have modified the queue system to prioritize veteran players. This feature is a work in progress.

author: Jamey
summary: Login queue deprioritizes accounts running more than one client at once.
quote: People with more than 1 client trying to login will now get less priority than people with 1 active account when there is a queue.

author: Akalix
summary: SEA launch with realms Ravenshire (Singapore) and Hogger (Russia); one-way EU->SEA transfers; EU and SEA networks cannot be technically connected, so no cross-network battlegrounds.
quote: it is not technically feasible for our Asian and European networks to be connected. This means we will not be able to have cross-network battlegrounds or any sort of shared infrastructure.

author: Torta
topic_title: TORTA :   Please respond on forced transfers
summary: No player will ever be transferred to another realm by force.
quote: We will not transfer anyone by force. You will have the choice to decide whether you want to play on a Chinese realm with Chinese support or stay on the European realm

author: Torta
topic_title: Status update, your concerns, and the future
summary: Post-mortem on the September 2023 queue crisis: unexpected 50,000 concurrent demand, no room for transfers, hardware and Chinese-speaking support both take time; 600-1000 support tickets daily per network.
quote: In hindsight, we should have offered more realms with enough room for the transfers. However, at the time, the idea of having 50,000 players trying to connect simultaneously to the modding project realms seemed too unrealistic to even consider.

author: Akalix
topic_title: New queue prioritization system is in place!
summary: Queue prioritization favours the English community on Turtle EU; EU is positioned for English players and the Asia network for CN players.
quote: Our new queue system provides priority for our English community on our Turtle EU realm ... our Turtle EU realm is primarily for our English community, and our Turtle Asia network is primarily for our CN community.

author: Torta
topic_title: You showed me the fairness of Europeans!
summary: The veteran-priority queue was not functioning as intended and was locking players out; transfers and a new Asian PvP realm were the planned fix.
quote: The current queue was designed to prioritize veteran players from both worlds, but unfortunately, it is not functioning as intended, resulting in many players being unable to log in.

author: Akalix
summary: EU realm player cap lowered by 3,000 from peak to 10,000 after CN realms opened, with fewer queues.
quote: We have lowered our playercap by 3,000 from peak (down to 10,000) and queues have still become less frequent.

author: Torta
summary: Automatic faction balancing restricts character creation for the dominant faction on the PvP realm.
quote: An automatic faction-balancing system will be implemented to prevent one faction from prevailing over the other. The server will automatically restrict character creation for a certain faction when specific conditions are met.

author: Torta
summary: A raid reset exploit fix is credited to an upstream VMaNGOS issue, confirming the server core lineage is vmangos/core.
quote: Fixed raid reset exploit: <https://github.com/vmangos/core/issues/791>

author: Akalix
summary: EU->SEA transfers are one-way, freeze the source account, exclude guilds and Tel'Abim, and cap carried wealth at 1000 gold and 40 of each trade good to prevent hoarding.
quote: This is a one-way transfer: There is no option to undo your transfer ... To prevent hoarding, players will be capped at: 1000 Gold. 40 of each "Trade Goods" material. Any items/gold in excess of this will be deleted.

author: Bowser
topic_title: Urgent Need for Enhanced Account Security
summary: Passwords are hashed, not plaintext; 2FA rolled out via the new website backend (already live on SEA with 30% adoption); optional email confirmation for password changes; IP-change confirmation ruled out due to dynamic IPs; backups encrypted and geographically distributed.
quote: we do not store passwords in plaintext ... we are in the process of rolling out Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) as part of our new website backend ... all of our database backups are encrypted and stored on multiple locations around the world.

author: Pepesmite
summary: The server sends identical packets to everyone; regional lag and disconnects are attributed to ISP routing, not server-side throttling.
quote: The server cannot intentionally give you a bad connection while giving other players a good one; it simply doesn't work that way.

author: Torta
topic_title: It's time to shutdown the PvP Server
summary: The PvP realm remains as a permanent option alongside the PvE realm.
quote: The PvP server will remain as an option alongside the PvE realm.

author: Torta
summary: The attack-power-reduction bug appeared only on EU realms and was traced to compiler/build-configuration behaviour, not to the source itself.
quote: The source code is fine. It's not broken on any local setups, PTR, or SEA realms. The issue exists only on EU realms, which is probably a very rare case of a compiler-specific bug related to the GCC version and build configuration on this machine.

author: Pepesmite
summary: Manual email changes were discontinued as an anti-theft and anti-account-sale measure.
quote: In order to enhance security measures and prevent account theft or sale, we have decided to discontinue the service of manually changing emails.

author: Reynolds
summary: Tel'Abim runs automated faction population balancing; freshly created level 1 characters no longer count toward it.
quote: Tel'Abim has automated faction pop balancing.

author: Akalix
topic_title: Suggest opening up new servers for the European server
summary: April 2025 position: no new EU realms unless the existing two are heavily over capacity — reversed four months later with Ambershire.
quote: We do not currently plan to add new realms until the two we have are heavily above capacity.

author: Sleeptime
summary: Race and faction changes are unavailable on Tel'Abim because the faction balance system blocks creating characters in an over-represented faction.
quote: race changes are not available on Tel'Abim due to the faction balance system. This system prevents players from creating new characters from a faction that is already considered to have "too many players."

author: Akalix
summary: Cross-faction play stays on Nordanaar; Tel'Abim is the non-cross-faction alternative.
quote: For a non-crossfaction server, I recommend Tel'Abim. We do not plan to remove crossfaction from Nordanaar.

author: Torta
summary: Ambershire RPPvE launched 17 Aug 2025, two days after patch 1.18.0, deliberately staggered so post-patch hotfixes land first; if either realm declines it merges into Nordanaar with Nordanaar name priority.
quote: The first 48 hours after a major patch are usually the most technically unstable. Giving ourselves a short window allows us to hotfix any unexpected issues before opening the new realm ... In that case, it'll be merged into Nordanaar. Nordanaar players and guilds will have name priority during the merge.

author: Torta
topic_title: 44k players online, and all want the same copper vein!
summary: Post-1.18.0 population figures: 44,000 peak concurrent across the network, ~500,000 active unique IPs, Ambershire 11,700 concurrent on launch day, Tel'Abim the only EU realm without cross-faction.
quote: Total peak yesterday: 44 000 players online. Total active players across all regions (unique IPs, multiboxing excluded): ~500 000

author: Torta
summary: Turtle states it upstreams relevant fixes and performance improvements to vMaNGOS, which any MaNGOS-based emulator may use.
quote: We've been in close contact with the vMaNGOS maintainers for years, making sure every fix or performance improvement relevant to their version gets ported back to their open-source repo. Any other MaNGOS-based emulators are absolutely free to use those changes.

author: Pepesmite
topic_title: if i lost my recovery keyword，how can get it one more time
summary: A lost account recovery keyword cannot be recovered or reissued.
quote: It is not possible to recover a keyword or create a new one for an account. If you lose your keyword, it will be lost permanently.

author: Torta
topic_title: Riding Skill and Mounts from Donation
summary: All mounts use dynamic speed scaled by riding skill (and by level for level-1 mounts), so any mount can be ridden at full speed with 150 riding.
quote: All mounts now have dynamic speed, the speed will adapt along with your riding skill. Now you can use level 1 or level 40 mounts at 100% speed if you have 150 Riding skill

author: Torta
summary: Cast times added to custom spells (Wormhole, Brainwashing Device, Planter) are intended and were only possible once client updates existed; the same-account mail delay change was reverted to 1 minute.
quote: Casting time for custom spells (WH, Brainwashing, Planter) will stay, I always wanted to set them but without having a client updates we had certain limitations. It's now working as intended.

author: Torta
summary: Melee leeway is confirmed buggy and not working as intended.
quote: The melee leeway feature indeed has issues, it's not intended to work as it is now.

author: Jamey
topic_title: PLEASE Fix the Blessings/Totems Buff Conflict Bug
summary: The blessing/totem conflict is not treated as a bug: retail vanilla never had shamans and paladins in one group so the buffs were never balanced to stack; behaviour deliberately left unchanged pending the class changes. Later reversed by the 2022 world-buff/stacking poll.
quote: We're aware of this "bug" ... retail/classic never had Shamans and Paladins being able to group up and thus it was never balanced around these buffs stacking ... For now, it will not be altered.

author: Torta
summary: Community poll on removing world buffs inside raids and letting totems+blessings stack; staff lists the exact power the buffs give and says the two changes must be made together.
quote: Removal of world buffs reduces the overall power creep that is attained by the players where it matters most: The raids ... +18% Spell Crit, +10% Melee Crit, 340 Attack Power, +10 Mana every 5 seconds, +15 Flat, and 15% increase to All Stats, +300 Health equal to 30 Stamina, +15% Melee Attack Speed and +10% Movement Speed.

author: Torta
summary: World-buff removal and totem/blessing stacking were bundled deliberately to avoid a one-sided power swing.
quote: the application of these things separately will cause a massive power influx in both ways depending on the change, which made it necessary for us to do them at the same time or not at all.

author: Torta
summary: World buffs would continue to work in the open world; only raid instances would strip them.
quote: the announcement states that world buffs would still affect characters in the open world, but they wouldn't work inside the raids.

author: Torta
summary: Long-standing emulator bug fixed: permanent periodic damage auras on creatures accelerated with server uptime until they one-shot nearby players.
quote: Fixed an ancient bug that caused permanent periodic damage auras on creatures, like the disease cloud on abominations, to start ticking faster and faster over time, eventually one-shotting players that go near the creature if server is online long enough.

author: Torta
summary: Turtle mount swim speed is independent of riding skill and equals half the mount's level-based speed.
quote: Turtle mount swimming speed is no longer affected by riding skills. It's half of the mount speed by level.

author: Torta
subsystem: Line of sight for chained spells
summary: Chain Lightning may jump to targets out of the caster's line of sight if they are in line of sight of another target; Grounding Totem works regardless of line of sight.
quote: Chain Lightning can now jump to targets not in the caster's line of sight, but within line of sight of another target. Grounding Totem will now work even if the caster or victim are not in line of sight.

author: Torta
summary: The debuff limit was raised from 24 to 64 server-side (the client frame still shows fewer).
quote: The debuff limit was increased from 24 to 64. You will not see them all under your enemy frame, but they're there server-side.

author: Torta
summary: World buffs disabled in Naxxramas, AQ40, AQ20, Zul'Gurub, Blackwing Lair and Molten Core, and in all future raid content.
quote: The following world buffs will no longer work in the raids, not in the existing ones, nor in the upcoming raiding content. The list of presently affected maps: Naxxramas, AQ40, AQ20, Zul'Gurub, Blackwing Lair, and Molten Core.

author: Akalix
summary: Beyond the community vote, world buffs were removed from raids because they scale differently per class and block class rebalancing.
quote: they massively restrict our ability to rebalance classes and change/add/remove spells. As world buffs impact different classes differently, they're a balancing nightmare. If we nolonger need to consider them, we are able to be much more flexible in our approaches to balancing.

author: Torta
summary: World buffs were left enabled in Onyxia's Lair by oversight and were disabled a week later; pets also had world buffs stripped on raid entry.
quote: Disabled world buffs in Onyxia's Lair (oversight of the previous update).

author: Jamey
summary: Two stat-stacking exploits fixed: weapon stats stacked via disarm effects, and ranged attack speed stacked via quivers.
quote: Fixed an exploit that allowed stacking weapon stats through disarm effects ... Fixed an exploit that allowed players to stack ranged attack speed through quivers.

author: Torta
summary: All mounts stay mounted in water (swim speeds unchanged); hardcore players are no longer PvP-flagged by accepting a PvP quest.
quote: You will now no longer dismount when mounted in water, this goes for ALL mounts. (Their swimming speeds are unchanged) ... Hardcore players will no longer be flagged for PvP when accepting a PvP quest.

author: Torta
summary: The level-based miss chance cap and spell resist cap now apply only to players, not creatures.
quote: The level based miss chance cap and spell resist cap now only applies to players.

author: Torta
summary: Reputation gains no longer scale down with level difference; Rage/Energy/Mana gains generate threat; melee spells put you in combat even when dodged, parried or blocked.
quote: All reputation gains now give 100% of their intended value, regardless of the level difference between your character and the quest/mob. Power gains of Rage/Energy/Mana (procs, energize ticks, potion use, etc) now properly generate threat as intended. Melee spells will now put you in combat even if they are dodged, parried, or blocked.

author: Jamey
summary: Frontstabbing is deliberately kept as a Turtle deviation, cited as proof the team does not fix every vanilla deviation reflexively.
quote: our reason to change the behavior of the item isn't simply "bug needs fixing". (We have frontstabbing for a reason)

author: Akalix
summary: Meditation now stacks correctly with other in-combat mana regeneration talents.
quote: Fixed issues related to the Meditation stat not stacking with similar mana regeneration in combat talents.

author: Torta
summary: The 200 ms delay between main-hand and off-hand swings was removed.
quote: Removed the 200 ms delay between main hand and of

author: Torta
summary: All attack-power reduction spells now correctly reduce NPC attack power; the root cause was OS/compiler-dependent behaviour that made it unreproducible in test environments.
quote: The root of the issue was that on specific OS and compiler versions, the code responsible for reducing Attack Power behaved differently, resulting in inconsistent behavior and making it difficult to track and fix the problem.

author: Reynolds
summary: Charge now stops at the outer edge of the target's combat range instead of the unit's centre.
quote: Charging now brings you to the outer edge of the target's combat range, rather than to the center of the unit.

author: Torta
summary: Because Class Changes 2 raised player power, level 10-57 NPCs get a 4-7% damage and health buff; a new BG queue system targets ghost queuing and team imbalance, rolled out on Tel'Abim first.
quote: NPCs in the mid-to-endgame (level 10 ~57) will be receiving a minor buff to damage and health values, these will range from 4-7% depending on their current values compared to the standard.

author: Jamey
summary: For 1.18.0 the 75% physical damage reduction cap from armor is removed and replaced with diminishing returns beyond 75%, because the hard cap was closing off build paths.
quote: Physical Damage Reduction from Armor is no longer capped at 75%. The extra reduction gained from Armor beyond this point will be diminished ... some classes and specializations are running into the issue of getting hard-capped by Armor. This severly limits their possible build paths.

author: Jamey
summary: Swapping Librams, Totems and Idols in combat now incurs a GCD; the previous behaviour was a quirk being abused, and the fix was elevated to a class-changes cycle because of its impact.
quote: Swapping Librams, Totems and Idols in combat now properly incurs a GCD. Developer Comment: This was an ongoing quirk that was being (ab)used.
